rgyas byang chub sa bon dag /legs pa nyid du mi skyed7pa/ /rgyu dang rkyen ni de yi phyir/ /sbyor ba rnams ni nyams par 'gyur/ /su yang rung ba gang zhig gis//byang chub sa bon rtogs gyur na/ /gang zag de yis7nges par ni/ /rnam dag 'od zer dpag med thob/ /zla 'od khyod kyis 'di lta bur / /'od zer 'di la sogs pa yi/ / rgyu dngasarkyen ni re re kun/ /so so tha dad nyid du ltos/ /khyod kyis7shes rab stobs kyis ni/ /thams cad de ltar rig par gyisaX/ /gang zhig mi dge57grogs spangs te/ /dge ba'i bshes gnyen la bsten byasani/ /tshul khrims rnam dag gang srung0)ba/ /sangs rgyas 'od zer sgrubasngo)par 'gyur/ /khyod kyis dbang po rab srungs51la/ /ngo tsha khrel med rab tu spongs/ /dge ba'i chos ni rab bsgomasam/rtel/ /sems can rnams ni bsrung〈nyebar gyis/ /khyod kyis tsortsod 8pa rab spongs la/ /stong nyid dag ni rtogs par gyis/ /rnyed pa dag la ma gdu bar( 7/ /mang thos legasanyebashad ldan5nyepar gyis/ /khyod kyis 3 )rnyed pa ru1dag la ni/ /mi gtsang lta bur blta bar gyis/ /rnyed pa'i dri ma dag gis ni/ /rnam dag sems ni sbagasamanyem byed/ /rnam par grol ba btsal bar byos/ /bla med rnyed pa thob par 'gyur/ /khyod kyis sangs rgyas lam bsgrubs la/ /sangs rgyas chos nyid 'dra bar ltos/ /chos kyi sgron chen rtag sbor shustel/ /'jig rten kun ni snang bar gyis/ /khyod kyi nyesems ni ri rgyal ltar / /mi g.yo nyid du rab tu byos/ /kha ngan dang ni brdegs pa yang /thams cad bzod pa dang du long〈 rme/ /khyod ni du shesems can rnams kyi phyir/ /dge bshes yang dag rab tu byos/ /dman pa'i sems ni yongs spongs la/ /rnam dag las ni rtag tu sgrubs4༷ / /khyod kyi5)sems ni5nyebartan byos la/ /bla 48wa 584

med chos ni rab tu ston/ /mdo sde dam pa 'di lta bu/ /brtse ba can la sbyin par gyis/ /bla med ye shes gang tsholatub/ /'khor ba dag lakhu'ajigs ma byedag/ /des nisnyisdig pa rnam spangs nas/ /phan yon mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /dper na blo dang ldan pa dag /me la7spyod parashemakhas pa gang / /ro rnams sna tshogs sbyin byed kyang / /mes ni sreg〈kyepar yong7mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig blo dang mi ldan pa/ /thabs dag la ni mi mkhas pas/ /me khyer lag mthil gang bzhag pa/ /mes ni rab tu sreg71par 'gyur/ /ji ltar mi zhig dug dag gis/ /sems ni 'khrugs nas myosalgepa gang / /me la rab tu bsros na7ni/ /de yi rgyu yis sos par 'gyur/ /zlasa'od khyod7kyis shes par gyis/ /blo dang ldan pa'ang de bzhin du/ /yid brten5)yid ni stong par rig /de phyir 'khor bar gnas kyang ni/ /mig brtenarwa)mig ni stong rig pas/ /mig la mngon par zhen pa med/ /gal te de ltar rab shes na(3/ /mig la gnas kyang nyon mongs med/ /gal te mig nyid stong rig na/ / yang dag ye shes sgrub par 'gyur/ kho nyeyang dag ye shes thob pa'i phyir/ /'od zer dag ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /gal te mig nyid stong rig na/ /'dod chags dag ni gtan nas spong / /'dod chags dag ni med pa'i phyir/ /'od zer dag ni 'byung bar 'gyur / /de bzhin zhe snang gti mug dang / /ngar 'dzin 'chab dang khromanyeb dang / /ser sna phrag dog ngo tsha med/ /mi bzod sems ni mtho ba dang / /rgyags dang mngon pa'i nga rgyal dang / /g.yo sgyu dang ni bag med dang / /gya gyu la sogs bar du yang ste/ /thams cad 'dod chags bzhin du bshad/ /yang dag ye shes thob gyur〈 nyen/ /mig ni〈9zhi ba nyid du rtogs/ /zhi ba nyid du 48—585

rtogs pa'i phyir/ /'od zer dag ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /yang dag ye shes thob gyur 17na/ /sangs rgyas tshul la rab tu gnas/ /tshul la rab tu gnas pa'i phyir/ /'od zer dag ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /yang dag ye shes thobashegyur na / /sangs rgyas thabs la gnas par 'gyur/ /thabs la rab tu gnas pa'i phyir / /'od zer dag ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /yang dag ye shes ma bsgrubs par la/ /sgrib pa dag ni gtan spong zhing / /'od zer 'byung ba sgrubasnyepar ni / /ngas 6)sngon ma thos ma mthongam7)ngo / /yang dag ye shes rab bsgrubs nas/ /sgrib pa'i gnod pa gtan spong zhing / /spyod pa 'di rjes gang 'brang ba/ /'od zer 'gyed pa thob 2)par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba'i spyod pa yongs tshol zhing / /mdo sde 'di la bslabs (byas nas3 )/ /de bzhin gshegs la5)gang mchod pa/ /yang dag ye shes thabs thob 'gyur/ /yang dag ye shes gang bsgrubasalgepa/ /sangs rgyas rnams la mchod par gyis/ /'od zer 'gyed pa rdzogs par 'gyur/ /lag mthil 'bras bu ji bzhin no/ /mig la bdag med gang rmongs pa/ /dge sbyong chos ni nyams par 'gyur/ /gang zag de yis de7)lta bu'i/ /'od zer 'gyed pa thob mi 'gyur/ /mig la bdag med gang rtogs pa/ /dge slong michos ni sgrub tshapar 'gyur/ /gang zag de yis de lta bu'i/ /'od zer 'gyed pa thob par 'gyur/ /mig gi samatha' zad gang rtogs pa/ /rna ba skye ba'i mtha' yang rtogs / /rna ba skye ba'i mtha' rtogs pas/ /dge sbyong chen po'i 8chos shes bya/ /gal te mig gi 12ngo bo nyid/ /mtha' ni yongs su ma shes na/ /mig ni skye ba'i mtha' dag kyang / /yongs su shes par mi 'gyur bas/ /gang zag de yis de lta bu'i/ /'od zer 'gyed pa thob mi 'gyur/ /gal te mig gi ngo bo nyid/ /40wa 586

mtha' ni yongs su shes gyur na/ /mig ni skye ba'i mtha' dag kyang / /yongs su shes pa nyid du 'gyur/ /gang zag de yis de0)lta bu'i/ /'od zer 'gyed pa thobashepar 'gyur/ /gal te mig gi ngo bo nyid/ /mtha' ni legs par ma shes na/ /mig ni skye ba'i mtha' dag kyang / /legs pa nyid du mi shes pas/ /gang zag de yis de lta bu'i/ /'od zer 'gyed pa thobadzaXmi 'gyur/ /gal te mig gi ngo bo nyid/ /mtha' ni legs par shes gyur na/ /mig ni skye ba'i mtha' dag kyang / /legs pa nyid du shes 'gyur bas/ /gang zag de yis de7lta bu'i/ /'od zer 'gyed pa thobalgepar 'gyur/ /gal te mig gi ngo bo nyid/ /mtha' ni mngon sum ma shes na/ /mig ni skye ba'i mtha' dag kyang / /mngon sum nyid du mi shes pas/ /gang zag de yis de lta bu'i/ /'od zer 'gyed pa thobaston)mi 'gyur/ /gal te mig gi ngo bo nyid/ /mtha' ni mngon sum shes gyur na/ /mig ni skye ba'i mtha' dag kyang / /mngon sum nyid du spurab shes pas/ /gang zag de yis de lta bu'i/ /'od zer 'gyed pa thobs par 'gyur/ /gal te mig gi ngo bo nyid/ /mtha' ni legs par ma shes na/ /mig ni skye ba'i mtha' dag kyang ske/ /yongs su shes par mi71'gyur bas/ /gang zag de yis de lta bu'i/ /'od zer 'gyed pa thobatsomi 'gyur/ /gal te mig gi ngo bo nyid/ /mtha' ni legs par shes gyur na/ /mig ni skye ba'i mtha' dag kyang / /mngon sum nyid du shes 'gyur bsa3nye/ /gang zag de yis de lta bu'i/ /'od zer 'gyed pa thob par 'gyur/ /gal te mig gi ngo bo nyid/ /rnam dag legs par ma shes na / /rnachaba'i ngo bo rnam dag pa/ /legs pa nyid du mi shes pas/ /gang zag de yis de lta bu'i/ /'od zer 'gyed pa thob 9mi 'gyur/ /1 gal te mig gi ngo 48—587

bo nyid/ /rnam dag legs par shes gyur na/ /rna ba'i ngo bo rnam dag pa/ /legs7pa nyid du rtogs 'gyur bas/ /gang zag de yis de lta bu'i/ /'od zer 'gyed pa thob5snyepar 'gyur/ /de bzhin sna dang lce dang lus/ /yid dngashegazugs mdza dri ro dang / /reg⑧bya chos dang sa chu dang / me rlung dag gikhudangos po dang / /'jig rten sdug bsngal phung po dang / /khams dang 'jig rten skye mchedamamedang / /sgra dang mingasal sogs pa yangashe/ /thams cad de bzhin rig par gyis/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /rigs kyi bu sems can gang theg pa chen po la yang dag par gzhol zhing 'od zer 'gyed pa de lta bu yongs su7rdzogs par bya bar 'dod pa des dge ba'i rtsa ba'i〈nyetshogs rnam pa brgyad⑥cu po 'di dag mngon par bsgrub par bya'o/ /rnam pa brgyadasacu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/sems can yongs su srung 8zhing rjes su dran pa dang / gnod sems med pa dang ske/ tshul khrims yongs su dag pa srung ⑩zhing nyams par mi byed pa dang /sems shin tu mnyam pa dang / g.yo sgyu med pa dang / ser sna med pa dang /phrag dog med pa dang / 'dod chags kyi bsam pa med pa dang / bslu ba'i bsam pa med pa dang / theg pa chen po'i mdo sde dam pa dag la mngon par yid ches pa dang / dbang phyug dang / rgyags pa la zhen cing sred pa med pa dang /bzod pa'i stobs phun sum tshogs (nyepa dang / smon lam las phyir mi ldog pa dang ske/ bsam pa shin tu rnam par dag par gyur pa dang / dgon pa na ⑩gnas pa dang / 'khor rnams la mi rten pa dang / rnyed pa la mi rten0 pa dang ske/ grags pa la mi rten (gepa dang / bsam gtan rnams la rab tu gnas 48—588

pa dang / 'od zer gyi ting nge 'dzin rab tu ston pa dang / tshul khrims dang ldan pa dag la7sgyu med par rim grosabyed pa dang / tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa dag la mchog gi bsam pa skyedarnyupa dang / chos la gus pa'i phyir mkhan po dang slob dpon dag dul shin tu bkur ba dang / mdo sde'i don rab tu rtogs pa dang / yang dag par bstan pa la rab tu mkhas pa dang / tshig smras pa dgashel mi bden pa med pa dang / yang dag pa'i bsam pa la gnas pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa lasnyibartson pa dang / rtag tu sbyin pa gtong ba dang / bdud kyi las rab tu rtogs pa dang / dbang po rnams dam du srung7 ba dang / tshig rab tu brtags pa dang / don dam pa'i bden pa la mkhas pa dang / sa rnams kyi rang gi mtshan nyid rab tu rtogs pa dang / gzungasamanyazad mi shes pa yongs su tshol ba dang / lus dang srog la phongs5)pa med pa dang ske/ 'khor bzhi po dag la rjes su ston par byed pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i bsam pa yongs su bcad pa dang / 'jig rten phyi ma'i chos med do zhes zer ba'i log par lta ba rnams spangs pa dang / da dung (nyem bslabs cipa dag lam gya gyu'i mtshan ma mi ston pa dang / gang bslab par 'dod pa dag la ci nus kyis 8rnam par phye nas rab tu ston pa dang / glu dang rol mo'i hu)sgra dag gi bsngags pa mi brjod pa dang ) / rgyan rgu)dngam yo byad kyi bsngags pa mi brjod pa dang / bden pa rnams la yang dag par zhugs pa dang / mang du thos pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / gnyid rab tu spangs pa dang / yang dag pa'i chos yongs su tshol ba la rab tu brtson pa dang / sangs rgyas la gus pa dang / byang chub tu sems bskyed pa dang / 'jig rten pa'i las yongs su spangs pa 2nyedang /48wa 589

bslab pa'i gnas rnams la yang dag par brtson pa dang / chos la sred pa'i phyir grogs khyad par can la rten hu)par byed pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams yongs su tshol ba la naskyo ba med pa dang / rab tu 'byungasheb la shin tu mos pa dang ske/ sangs rgyas kyi chos srung ④zhing yongs su 'dzin par byed pa dang / sdig pa'i las mi slong ba 'anadang / bstan pa rnams la the tshom med pa dang du/dpes ston pa la rab tu mkhas pa dang / gsang ba rnamasashernam par phye nas ston par byed pa dang / byang chub chen po yongs su tshol ba la ngal ba med pa dang ske/ mdo sde yang dag par bzung ba rnams brjed7par mi byed pa dang /rang gi bslab pa mi spong ba dang / pha rol gyi smra ba rnams tshar gcod pa dang /nges par 'byung ba'i lam yongs su tshol5nyab dang / spyod pa tshad med pa rnams mngon par sgrub nyugepa dang / chos kyi ye shes de dag la sems nges par gyur pa dang ske/ rgyu dang 'bras bu gsal bar mthong zhing 'khor ba'i rgyun mi gcod pa dang ske/ srid pa gsum po dag la chags pa med pa dang / mngon pa'i nga rgyal spangs pa dang / mngon par yid ches pa dag la gnyenatshwanyepo rnam par gzhag pa dag skoston par byed pa dang / ma 'ongs pa'i 'bras bu rnam par smin pa'i bye brag rtogs par khong du chud pa dang / sngon gyi mtha' yongs su legs par shes pa dang / gzhan gyi dring la mi ltos pa dang / yongs su spong ba'i spyod pa dag la brtson 'grus kyis grubs par byed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi mtshan dang dpe byad kyi bkod pa dag phun sum tshogs hu snapar byed pa gang yin pa 'di ni rnam pa nyu8brgyad cu zhes bya'o/ /gzhan yang zla 'odam/rtsegazhon nu chos brgyad cu po 'di dag ni chos lnga'i nang du 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /chos lnga gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/48wa 590

'khor ba shes pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa shes pa dang / nyon mongs pa zad pa shes pa dang / mchog tu gyur pa shes pa dang / bsod nams7kyi 'bras bu shes pa gang yin pa'o/ /gzhan yang zla 'od gzhon nu chos lnga po de dag ni chos gnyis kyi nang du 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /gnyis gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/sems yongs su dag pas rab tu brgyan pa dang / gzugs yongs su dag pas rab tu brgyan pa gang yin⑧pa'o/ /gzhan yang zla 'od gzhon nu chos gnyis po de dag ni chos gcig gi nang du 'jug par 'gyur ro ri/ /gcig gang zhe na/'di lta ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i rnam par grol ba mngon par grub pa gang yin pa'o/ /gzhan yang zla 'od gzhon nu yang chos rnam pa brgyad cu ⑤yod de/ de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i rnam par grol ba legs par yongs su rdzogs par byed pa'odu / /rnam pa brgyad cu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i tshogs dang /shes rab rgya chen por gyur pa dang / tshul khrims bla)rnam par dag pa yongs su sgrubalgepa dang / nyon mongs pa'i gdung ba dang bral ba dang / nga rgyal rab tu bcomashepa dang / tshig mnyen 7pa dang / dngos po sna tshogs rab tu shes pa dang ske/ dge ba'i grogs po yongs su shes pa dang / theg pa chen po la yang dag par gzhol ba dang / brtson 'grus kyi go cha bgos pa dang / spyod lam gyis sems can 'dul ba dang / nyon mongs par ltung 31ba rnams kyi the tshom rab tu gcod pa dang / mi dge ba rnams la smod cing chos 32dkar po rnams mngon par bsgrubalgepa dang / mi dge ba'i grogs po dang mi 'grogs pa dang / dge ba'i rtsa ba rnams bskyed pa la yongs su skyo ba med pa dang / byang chub tu sems 48—591

bskyed pa dang / brtson 'grus rab tu rtsom7pa dang / bdud kyi dngos po rab tu rtogs pa dang / bden pa rnams mngon du gyur pa dang / yang dag pa kho nar mchod pa byed pa dang / the tshom yongs su gcod pa dang / sems kyisashertag tu sems can yongs su rgyabazla ④bar sems pa dang / srid pa rnams la mngon par zhen pa med pa dang / sems rgya chen po yongs su bskyed pa dang /sems can mi dge ba rnams la nyes dmigs yang dag par ston pa dang /'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug rab tu spong ba dang / 'dod pa'i phan pas5)yongs su mi tshol ba dang / sems can yongs su smin par byedashepa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten 'chosalgepa dang / 'phags pa rnams la gus pa skyed she)pa dang / theg pa chen po la gnas pa dag la rten cing rim gro nyu1byed pa dang / theg pa dman pa dag gi bsngags5nyepa mi brjod pa dang /nyan thos kyi theg pa pa dag hu3thag ring du spong ba dang / phyir rgol ba rnams tshar gcod pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la mchod pa rgya chen po bshams nas khyad par du 'phags pa'i sems kyis dbul〈nyebar byed pa dang /thogs pa med pa'i ye shes thob pa dang / spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang /dpe sna tshogs kyis nyu yang dag pa'i7)chos rab tu ston par byed pa dang / stong pa'i ngo bo nyid dang 'gal bar mi byed pa dang / chos yongs su tshol ba la le lo med ru )pa dang / don zab mo ji 7yang dag par ston pa dang / gzungs chen po dang ldan pa dang / chos yang dag par ston par byed kyang mngon par zhen pa med pa dang / chos rgya cher spel bar byed pa dang / yongs su 'dren pa la chog5nyeshes pa med pa dang / spyod pa rnams yongs su rdzogs pa dang / gzi byin nye48—592

chen po dang ldan pa dngatu/ spobs pa thogs pa med pa dngashe/ mang du thos pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / mi dge ba rnams nikyi bsngags 4)pa mi rjod (nyepa dang / dge ba'i las yang dag par sgrub pa dang / phung po rnams7)khong du chud pa dang / lta ba rnams rab tu spangs pa dang / rgyu'i ngo bo nyid rab tu rtogs pa dang / spyod yul las yang dag par 'das pasadang / spyod yul ma yin pa yongs su spangs pa dang / yongs su dang ba skyed7pa dang / yang dag pa'i lam la gnas pa dang / theg pa chen po la rab tu dga' ba dang / mnyam pa nyid du yongs su sdud par byed pa dang / bdag med pa la mngon par ma chags pa dang / 'khor ba la yongs su skyo ba med pa dang / mya ngan las 'das pa yongs su tshol ba la mos pa dang / 'dod pa chung ba'i phyir dgon pa la (3 gnas pa dang / rtag tu bsod snyoms slong zhing le lo med par gyur pa dang /ji tsam rnyed pa de nyid kyis chog par 'dzin pa dang / ngo tsha med pa dang /khrel med pa spangs pa dang / sangs rgyas rnams la bsnyen par byed pa dang /dge ba'i grogs po dang lhan cigarwarnyeganas pa dang / bdag gi zla5)ma hunyeyin pa rnams rab tu spong ba dang / so so'i skye bo rnams la snying brtse ba dang / sems can gyi spyod pa dang 'thun par byed pa dang / sangs rgyas la shin tu dang ba dang / snod ma yin pa yongs su spong ba dang / mi 'thun pa rnams la tshig sbyin par mi byed pa dang / gsol ba mi 'debs pa dgatsol yang dag par ston par mi byed pa dang / gsol ba 'debs pa zhig 'ongs na〈nyeci rigs par ston par byed pa dang / zas la snyoms par gyur pa dang / rtag tu gtong zhing mnyam pa nyid du gtong ba dang / sgo chen po phye nas gtong b.rarwa)byed pa gang 48—593

yin pa de 3)dag ni gzhon nu chos rnam pa brgyad cu ces bya ste/ 'di dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i rnam par grol ba thob par byed do/ /de'i tshe zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pas〈chos de lta bu thos pasanyerab tu dga' bar gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyi spyanaphusngar tshigs su bcad de mngon par bstod pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa mig⑧zad mtha' mkhyen pas/ /de slad rnam dag ye shes ston mdzad lelags/ /rnam dag ye shes ston par mdzad pas na48)ske/ /rnam dag 'od zer phun sum tshogs ⑨pa lags7/ /de bzhin gshegs pas mig bdag med mkhyen pas/1/ /de slad rnam dag dbyangs ni ston mdzad lags / /rnam dag dbyangs ni ston par mdzad pas na/ /tshangs dbyangs mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs pa lags/ /bcom ldan sngon ni sems can phan btags 12pas/ /de slad rnam dag gsung ni rdzogs pa lags/ /rnam dag gsung ni yongs su rdzogs pas na/ /'jig rten tshad med rnams la phan 'dogs hunyemadzad / /de bzhin gshegs pas mig nyid stong mkhyen pas/ /de slad kun 'dzin mkhyen pa rdzogs pa lags/ /kun 'dzin mkhyen pa yongs su rdzogs pas na / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od zer dpag med ston/ /de bzhin gshegs pas mig gi khyad par mkhyenas/ /mig gi khyad par dag kyang mtha' ma mchis/ /mkhyen pa'i ming ni dpag tu ma mchis pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od zer dpag med ston/ /sangs rgyas yi ge khyad par sgo mkhyen pas/ /mig stong yi ge bral bar rab tu mkhyen/ /mig 8stong yi ge bral bar mkhyen pas na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od zer dpag med ston/ /gang zhig mig la bdag med rab sems pa/ /sangs rgyas gsung ni bden pa nyid du rtogs/ / sangs rgyas 48—594

gsung ni bden par rtogs pas na/ 9)de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'od zer nges pa ston②ske/ /bcom ldan rdzu 'phrul mchog ni yongs rdzogs pas/ /mig gi 'jigadza pa dpag med thugs su chud/ /mig gi 'jig⑧pa rab tu mkhyen pas na/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan 'dogs mdzad/ /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /mig gi skye ba dpag med rab tu mkhyen/ /ji ltar bcom ldan mig gi skye mkhyen padu/ /bdag kyang ring por mi thogs de bzhin shog /de bzhin rna ba sna dang lce lus yid/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dag dang chos/ /'jig rten skye dang sgra dang ming la sogs/ /thams cad la yangatso)de bzhin rab tu mkhyen/ /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol byon7pa phun sum tshogs/ /ji ltar bcom ldan sbyin pa'i pha rol byonam/ /bdag kyang ring por mi thogs de bzhin shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /tshul khrims rnam dag pha rol byon 31dang ldan/ /ji ltar bcom ldan tshul khrims pha rol byonatso/ /bdag kyang ring por mi thogs de bzhin shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /bzod pa'i pha rol byon /rtepa phun sum tshogs/ /ji ltar bcom ldan bzod pa'i78pha rol byon8/ /bdag kyang ring por mi thogs de bzhin shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /brtson 'grus pha rol byon pa phun sum tshogs/ /ji ltar bcom ldan brtson 'grus pha rol byon⑩/ /bdag kyang ring por mi thogs de bzhin shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /bsam gtan pha rol byonatshwa)pa phun sum tshogs / /ji ltar bcom ldan bsam gtan pha rol byon /rte/ /bdag kyang ring por mi thogs de bzhin shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /40wa 595

shes rab pha rol byonas)1pa phun sum tshogs/ /ji ltar bcom ldan shes rab pha rol byon / /bdag kyang ring por mi thogs de bzhin shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /chos sku'i pha rol byon⑧pa phun sum tshogs/ /ji ltar bcom ldan chos sku'i pha rol byonadu/ /bdag kyang ring por mi thogs de bzhin shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /rnam dag gzugs ni dpag med phun sum tshogs/ /ji ltar bcom ldan rnam dag gzugs ldan pa/ /bdag kyang ring por mi thogs de bzhin shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /rnam dag yid ni dpag med phun sum tshogs/ /ji ltar bcom ldan rnam dag yid ldan pa/ /bdag kyang ring por mi thogs de bzhin shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /yon tan mchog ni dpag med phun sum tshogs/ /ji ltar bcom ldan yon tan mchog ldan pa/ /bdag kyang ring por mi thogs de bzhin shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /gzugs kyi mtshan ni dpag med phun sum tshogs/ /ji ltar bcom59)ldan gzugs kyi mtshan ldan pa/ /bdag kyang ring por mishethogs de bzhin shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /rnam dag sgra ni dpag med phun sum tshogs/ /ji ltar bcom ldan rnam dag sgra ldan pa/ /bdag kyang ring por mi thogs de bzhin shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /rdzu 'phrul chen po dpag med phun sum tshogs/ /ji ltar bcom ldan rdzu 'phrul cher 48)ldan pa/ /bdag kyang ring por mi thogs de bzhin shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /sems can gdul7slad srid pa gsum na bzhugs/ /ji ltar bcom ldan sems can gdul mdzad pa/ /48—596

bdag kyang ring por mi thogs de bzhin shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /'khor ba'i spyod pa dpag med dag las 'das/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'khor ba'i spyod 'das pa/ /bdag kyang ring por mi thogs de bzhin shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /'dod chags spyod pa dpag med dag las 'das/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'dod chags spyod 'das pa/ /bdag kyang ring poratumi thogs de bzhin shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /zhe snang spyod pa dpag med dag las 'das/ /ji ltar bcom ldan zhe snang spyod 'das pa/ /bdag kyang ring por7mi thogs de bzhin shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /gti mug spyod pa dpag med dag las 'das/ /ji ltar bcom ldan gti mug spyod 'das pa/ /bdag kyang ringasapor mi thogs de bzhin shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /'dod chags zhe snang spyod pa dpag med 'dasadu/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'dod snang0spyod 'das pa/ /bdag kyang ring por mi thogs de bzhin shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /zhe snang gti mug spyod pa dpag med 'das/ /ji ltar bcom ldan sdang rmongs spyod 'das pa/ /bdag kyang ring por mi thogs de bzhin shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /'dod chags gti mug spyod pa dpag med 'das/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'dod rmongs spyod 'das pa/ /bdag kyang ring por mi thogs de bzhin shog /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa/ /cha mnyam spyod pa dpag med yang dag 'das/ /ji ltar bcom ldan cha mnyam spyod 'das pa/ /bdag kyang ring por mi thogs de bzhin shog /'dren pa 'dod chags dag las yongs 'das pas⑥/ /'jig 48—597

rten kun la shin tu phan 'dogs mdzad/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'jig rten phan 'dogs pa/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grubatupar shog /'dren pa zhe snang dag las yongs 'das pasame/ /'jig rten kun la shin tu phan 'dogs mdzad//ji ltar bcom ldan 'jig rten phan 'dogs pa/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shesakhugrub par shog /'dren pa gti mug spyod las yongs 'das pas0/ /'jig rten kun la shin tu phan 'dogs mdzad/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'jig rten phan 'dogs pa/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub par shog /'dren pa 'dod chags zhe snang ④spyod 'das pasal/ /'jig rten kun la shin tu phan 'dogs mdzad / /ji ltar bcom ldan 'jig rten phan 'dogs pa/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub par shog / sgo'adren pa zhe snang gti mug spyod 'das pas/ /'jig rten kun las stishin tu phan 'dogs mdzad/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'jig rten phan 'dogs pa/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub par shog /'dren pa 'dod chags gti mug spyod 'das pas/ /'jig rten kun las shin tu phan 'dogs mdzad/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'jig rten phan 'dogs pa/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub par shog /'dren pa chags snang lhoskregati mug spyod 'das pas/ /'jig rten kun las7shin tunyephan 'dogs mdzad/ /ji ltar bcom ldan 'jig rten phan 'dogs pa/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub par shog ci /8de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pasatso/ /lha tshogs mang po thams cad 'dul bar mdzad/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nasal/ /lha misngor kha lo sgyur thortseba'i ston par shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pas/ /klu tshogs mang po thams cad 'dul bar mdzad/ /bdag 48—598

kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /lha mi 1kha lo sgyur 5ba'i ston par shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pas/ /gnod sbyin mang po thams cad 'dul bar mdzad/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub — ༄gyur nas/ /lha mis rikha lo sgyur53)ba'i ston par shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pas nye/ /dri za thams cad rab tu 'dul mdzad cing / /de bzhin grul bum dpag tu ma mchis pa/ /'khor bcas ji snyed rab tu 'dul bar mdzad/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /lha mi 7kha lo sgyur 8ba'i ston par shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pas/ /chos rnams yang dag don ni rab tu mkhyen/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /yang dag des9la the tshom ma mchis shog /de bzhin gshegs pa 1 sdug bsngal zad mtha' 11mkhyen/ /skye dgu lha thams cad la ni phan 'dogs 1 mdzad/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /sdug bsngal zad la the tshom ma mchis shog /de bzhin gshegs pas rgyu lazad mtha' mkhyen pas/ /skye dgu lothams cad la ni phan 'dogs mdzad/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /rgyu 7zad de la the tshom ma mchis shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pas/ /'jig rten spyod pa dag ni rab tu mkhyen/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten spyod la the tshom ma mchis shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pas/ /'jig rten gnas dang gnas med rab tu mkhyen/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pas/ /'jig rten las dang 'bras bu rab tu mkhyen7/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur 48—599

nas / /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pas/ /'jig rten rang bzhin sna tshogs rab tu mkhyen/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pas/ /thams cad kun du 'gro ba'i spyod pa mkhyen/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pas/ /'jig rten mos pa sna tshogs rab tu mkhyen/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pas/ /dbang po rnams kyi rang bzhin thams cad mkhyen/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pas/ /bsam gtan spyod pa dag ni rab tu mkhyen/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pas/ /rnam par thar pa'i spyod pa rab tu mkhyen/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pas/ /cha mnyam spyod pa dag ni rab tu mkhyen/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pas/ /snyoms 'jugatuspyod pa dag ni rab tu mkhyen / /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shogase /de bzhin gshegs pashe'akhor ba rab mkhyen pas/ /48—600

'khor ba nyon mongs rgyu7)las skyes par mkhyen/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pas thams cad dunarab mkhyen pas/ /'jig rten phan 'dogs dpe zla yong ③ma mchis/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pas gting 'dzin rab gnas pas/ /khyad par thabs kyi ye shes skyedam par mdzad/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pas/ /sngon gyi gnas kyi spyod pa dpag med mkhyen/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pas/ /'chi 'pho skye ba dpag med rab tu mkhyen/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pas/ /nyon mongs zad pa thams cad rab tu mkhyen/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pas / /bla med byang chub yang dag mngon sangs rgyas/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pas/ /nyon mongs bag chags dag ni rab tu spangs/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pas / /'khor ba nges 'byung chos ni rab tu mkhyen/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye 40wa 601

shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pas chos don 1rab mkhyen pas/ /sems can dpag med rnams ni go bar mdzad/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pas chos nyid sgyu ma dang //rmi lam smig rgyu 5lta bur rab tu mkhyen/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas / /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pas 'jig rten thams cad kyi/ /yi ge dag dang brjod pa rab tu mkhyen/ /bdag kyang /de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pa spobs pa mchog ldan pas/ /dam chos zab mo dag ni ston par mdzad/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pa casku gsung thugs dul sgrubs/ /thams cad ye shes rjes su 'brang bar mdzad/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pas dus gsum rab mkhyen pas / /'dzin dang chags pa mi mnga' thogs mi snyamanga'/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /'jig rten thams cad la ni phan bgyid shog /de bzhin gshegs pas tshul khrims ting 'dzin dang / /shes rab bsgrubs pas de las ldog mi 'gyur/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /khams gsum thugs rje chen po'i gtsor gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pas rnam grol rab bsgrubs pas/ /rnam grol mkhyen dang gzigs pa ldog mi mnga'/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /khams gsum thugs rje chen po'i gtsor gyur cig /de bzhin 40wa 602

gshegs pas zhi gnas lhag mthong bsgrubs/ /lha mi 1 'jig rten dag na mtshungs ma mchis/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /khams gsum thugs rje chen po'i gtsor gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen pa mchog ldan pas/ /'jig rten chos rnams la ni zhen mi mnga'/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /khams gsum thugs rje chen po'i gtsor gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pas na 'jig rten dmakhyen ldan pas/ /'gro ba sna tshogs dag ni gsal bar gzigs/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas / /'gro ba de la the tshom ma mchis shog /de bzhin gshegs pa'5skye zad mtha' mkhyen pas/ /de slad de la rmongs pa yong ne mi mnga'/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /skye zad nyid la the tshom ma mchis shog /de bzhin gshegs pas rab zhi mtha' mkhyen pas/ /de slad de la rmongs pa yong 7mi mnga'/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /rab zhi de la the tshom ma mchis shog /de bzhin gshegs pa na 'khor ba'i mtha' mkhyen pas/ /de slad de la rmongs pa yong mi mnga'9/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas / /'khor ba de la the tshom ma mchis shog /de bzhin gshegs pas sngon dang phyi mtha' mkhyen/ /de slad 7slob dpon ma mchis mkhyen dang ldan/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /snga phyi'i mtha' la the tshom ma mchis shog /de bzhin gshegs pas skyon zlog 11mtha' rab mkhyen/ /de slad slob dpon ma mchis mkhyen dang ldan/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /skyon zlog /2de la the tshom ma mchis shog /de bzhin gshegs pas sngon dang phyi mtha' mkhyen/ /mig gi rtag chad dag la 'dzin mi mnga'/ /bdag kyang de 48—603

'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /snga phyis3)mtha' la the tshom ma mchis shog /de bzhin gshegs pas skye zad mtha' mkhyen pas/ /mig gi na rtag chad dag la5 kyi'adzin mi mnga'/ /bdag kyang de 'dra'i ye shes grub gyur nas/ /skye zad nyid la the tshom ma mchis shog /gang zhig sngon dang phyi mtha' ma rtogs pas grwa/ /desamarani 'dod pa dag la zhen pa skyed na/ /de bzhin gshegs pas de ni rab mkhyen pas / /de slad 'dod pa dag la zhen mi mnga'/ /gang zhig yod med mtha' ni ma rtogs pa / /des ni 'dod pa dag la zhen pa skyed(7/ /de bzhin gshegs pas de ni rab mkhyen pas/ /de slad 'dod pa dag la zhen mi mnga'/ /gang zhig zad dang mi zad ma rtogs pa9chos/ /des ni 'dod pa dag la zhen pa skyedakyi/ /de bzhin gshegs pas de ni rab mkhyen pas/ /de slad 'dod pa dag la zhen mi mnga'am/ /gang zhig 'jug dang mi 'jug ma rtogs pa/ /des ni 'dod pa dag la zhen pa skyed11/ /de bzhin gshegs pasatshwa de ni rab mkhyen pasatsho / /de slad 'dod pa dag la zhen mi mnga'/ /zhe sdang gti mug khong khrosa'achab pa dang / /g.yo sgyu phrag dog nga rgyal khengs pa dang / /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod dang brtson 'grus dang / /bsam gtan shes rab dag kyang de bzhin no/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa'i sems kyi rtog 8pa thugs kyis mkhyen nas 'dzum pa mdzad del/ 'od zer gser 1 7gyi sna kha dog lta bu rab tu bkye'o/ /'od zer des kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med dpag tu med pa rnams snang bar byas te/ 'jig rten gyi /6khams de dag tu phan rdu 7pa dag byas nasal/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor nyid du thim 21par gyur to/ /de nas de'i tshe byang chub sems 40wa 604

dpa' byams pa 'dug pa'i 3)stan las langs nas ni/ /bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzaram te/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lham )nga sa la btsugs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyiphan)zhabs la mgo bos phyag byas 5)te/ gus pas thal mo sbyar nas/ tshigs su bcad pa 'di 6)dag gis rin/mngon par bstod de/ bcom ldan 'das la zhu ba zhus pa/ 'brug dang seng ge'i sgra sgrogs shing 9/ /ka la ping ku'i sgra phyung bsakyi / /chos rnga chen po'i 11sgra 'byin pa12/ /ci yi slad du 'dzum pa mdzad/ /nyi ma stong pas khyad par 'phags/ /rnam dag 1 sgra rab dag dang ldan/ /yon tan ngo mtshar rab mnga' ba/ /ci slad 'od zer bkye ba mdzad/ /sbyin dang skatshul khrims bzod brtson 'grus/ /bsam gtan shes rab rab brgyan pas/ /thams cad dag ni yongs rdzogs pas3nya/ /ci slad 'od zer bkye ba mdzad/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dbyangs mnyen pasal/ /ngag rtsub rnams ni rtag 1 tu spangs/ /sems can nad ni legs gso ba/ /ci slad 'od zer bkye ba 18mdzad/ /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis gtso/ /mig ni rtag tu stong dben mkhyen/ /rnam dag tshangs pa'i dbyangs mnga' bas/ /sems can rnams la chos 19ston 3 mdzad / /rna ba sna lce lus dang yid/ /sgra dang ming la 21sogs pa nas/ /kun 'byung 'gog pa lam dag dang / /ye shes bzod pa'i bar 22de bzhin/ /thugs rje chen po rkang gnyis gtso/ /mig zad skye ba'i mtha' dag dang / /rab zhi dag ge ni 'khor ba dag /thams cad stong dben nyid du mkhyen/ /rna ba sna lce lus dang yid/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya nas/ /sgra dang ming la 2 sogs pa'i bar/ /thams cad kyang ni dgede bzhin no/ /gzhan yang rten cing 27'brel 'byung chos/ /chad dang rtag pa yongs 2 bral nas/ /bdag dang gzhan gyis 2848wa 605

byas min pas/ /rkyen mang 1las byung nanyid du gsungs kyi/ /res 'ga' rnam grangs sna tshogs kyis/ /sdug bsngal gzhi la ni ston par rimadzad/ /res 'ga' don ni sna tshogs kyis / /sangs rgyas 'od zer bsngags par mdzad/ /res 'ga' tshig ni tshad med 7 kyis/ /rab dben chos ni ston mdzad cing / /gang zag srog dang bdag med dang / /sems can med pa nyid du ston/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas tshad med kyang / /bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag girin/ /tshigs su bcad pa brgya stong gis/ /de 'dra'i chos ni ston par mdzad/ /de bzhin gshegs pas 9yon tan chos/ /yang dag nyid ni ston mdzad kyang / /rjod spudang brjod 11bya mi mnga' bas/ /brjod 12mdzad chos kyang yong mi mnga'/ /bcom ldan yang dag chos gsung 1 zhing / /skye dgu mirnams ni go mdzad pas/ /lha rnams dang ni gnod sbyin dag /gang thos de dag rtogs par 'gyur/ /lha ma yin ni thams cad kyang / /mos pa dag ni rnam par dag /mi mni mang po tshad med kyang / /the tshom dra ba chad par gyur/ /'dod chags rang bzhin rab tu rtogs / /zhe sdang gti mug rnam par bshig /sred tshadang nga rgyal ma rig dang / /g.yo sgyu phrag dog spros 1 pa nas/ /sdug bsngal phung po las1shesogs par19/ /thams cad kyang ni yongs su spangs/ /'di la 2 sogs pa'i 21tshig gi don/ /mthar 2ni kun kyang rnam par dag /de bzhin gshegs pas chos gcig la/ /sna tshogs ming ni rab mkhyen pas/ /grangs ni brgya stong mang po rnams/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rab tu ston/ /sangs rgyas tshad med mang po las snye /de 'dra'i chos ni legs bslabs 2 pas/ /chos kyi dngos po gcig la yang 25/ /brjod pa thug 20pa med pa ston/ /de bzhin gshegs pas chos rnams kyi/ /rnam 48wa 606

grangs sna tshogs rab mkhyen pas/ /ming tshig dang po bar ma dang / /tha ma rnam 'byed rab tu mkhyen/ /tha dad tshig ni sna tshogs dag /thams cad rab tu bslabasam1pas na/ /don mchog dag ni gya rnam pa/ /ston pa dag ni 2rab tu mkhyen / /de 'dra'i dbyangs ni rnam dag pa/ /rgyu rkyen tshogs pa las byung bsal/ /lce 'ba'am zhig la rten 5pa nas/ /lus sems bar la rten 6pa'ang min / /sa ni rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ /phyogs bcu'i 'khor ni 7yongs 'dus nas / /thal sbyar bcom ldan zhal lta 8na/ /the tshom dag ni bsal du gsol/ /de bzhin gshegs pas mig zad dang 9/ /skye mtha' dag 1 ni rang bzhin gyis/kā / /rtag tu stong zhing dben pa dang / /'gro 'ong med par rab tu mkhyen/ /bzhugs dang gnas ni mi mnga' bas/ /yang dag mtha' la rab tu bzhugs/ /bcom ldan spyan ni thogs mi mnga'/ /de slad 12deng bdag zhu ba lags/ /de bzhin gshegs pas mig nyid kyi/ /sngon dang phyi ma'i mtha' dag dang / /zad dang ma zad 'khor ba ni/ /rang bzhin stong dben rab mkhyen pas/ /chos kyi don rnams rab phye nas/ /'jig rten rnams ni dga' bar mdzad/ /thub pa dbyangs snyan rab mnga' bas/ /ci slad 'dzum pa ston par mdzad/ /bcom ldan sngon dang phyi 1snyematha' dang / /mig nyid stong dben rab mkhyen cing / /rnam rtog tshig dang bral lags na/ /ci slad 'dzum pa ston par mdzad/ /bcom ldan mig ni dpag med dang / /brjod pa sna tshogs rang bzhin 7gyis/ /rtag tu stong dben mkhyen lags tshan/ /ci slad 'dzum pa ston par mdzad/ /bcom ldan zad dang skye mtha' dang / /mig nyid stong dben tsharab mkhyen cing //nyon mongs rnams ni yongs spangs pas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub mkhyen pa brnyes//40wa 607

grags pa mchog ni phun sum tshogs1)/ /ci slad 'dzum pa ston par mdzad/ /bcom ldan yun ring bsgom bslabs 5)pas/ /bsam gyis mi khyab ston par mdzad / /mig nyid stong pa nyid du mkhyen/ /dri bral rtag tu rnam par dag /sems kyi spyod pa tshad med rnams/ /dgongs pa gcig gis thams cad mkhyen/ /'od zer 'jig rten snang mdzad pa/ /'di ni gang gi snga rtags lags/ /drang srong chen po mngon sangs rgyas/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo khyad par 'phags/ /nyon mongs dag nis rab bsal labs/ /thugs ni rtag tu zhi zhing dben/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mkhyen mchog gis/ /mig zad mtha' ni rab tu rtogs/ /rgyu dang rkyen ni gang gi slad/ /deng 'dir 'dzum pa ston par mdzad/ /rna ba sna lce lus dang yid/ /yul drug dang ni 'byung chen bzhi/ /sgra dang ming la55)sogs pa'i bar/ /thams cad kyang ni de bzhin no/ /bcom ldan mig la bdag med mkhyen / /rna ba mi rtag 6nyid du rtogs kyi/ /sna nyid stong par rabamagumakhyen nayo)/ /ci slad 'dzum pa ston par mdzad/ /bcom ldan lce la bdag med mkhyen/ /lus kyang mi rtag nyid du rtogs/ /sems yid ’ ristong par rab mkhyen na/ /ci slad 'dzum pa ston par mdzad/ /bcom ldan gzugs la bdag med mkhyen/ /sgra yang mi rtag 11nyid du rtog12 /dri nyid stong par rab mkhyen na/ /ci slad 'dzum pa ston par mdzad/ /bcom ldan ro la bdag med mkhyen/ /reg bya mi rtag nyid du rtogs/ /chos nyid stong par rab mkhyen na/ /ci slad 'dzum pa ston par mdzad/ /bcom ldan sa la bdag med mkhyen/ /chu yang mi rtag nyid du rtogs/ /me nyid stong par rab mkhyen na/ /ci slad 'dzum pa ston par mdzad / /bcom ldan rlung la bdag med mkhyen/ /ngo bo mi rtag nyid du rtogs/ /40wa 608

dngos nyid stong par rab mkhyen nanyu)/ /ci slad 'dzum pa ston par mdzad/ /bcom ldan 'jig rten bdag med mkhyen/ /sdug bsngal mi rtag nyid du rtogs/ /phung po stong par rab mkhyen na/ /ci slad 'dzum pa ston par mdzad/ /bcom ldan khams la bdag med mkhyen(9/ /'jig rten mi rtag nyid du rtogs/ /skye nyid stong par rab mkhyen na/ /ci slad 'dzum pa ston par mdzad/ /bcom ldan sgra la bdag med mkhyen/ /ming yang mi rtag nyid du rtogs/ /lam nyid stong par rab mkhyen na / /ci slad 'dzum pa ston par mdzad/ /bcom ldan ye shes bdagashogemed mkhyen/ /rab dben mi rtag nyid du rtogs/ /sems can stong par rab mkhyen na/ /ci slad 'dzum pa ston par mdzad/ /bcom ldan rang bzhin rang bzhin med/ /bdag dang bdag med pa yang mkhyen/ /mos pa stong55)par rab mkhyen na/ /ci slad 'dzum pa ston par mdzad/ /'khor ba bdag med nyid du gzigs/ /rtag dang mi rtag pa yang mkhyen/ /mya ngan 'das pa56)stong〈pemakhyen na/ /ci slad 'dzum pa ston na par mdzad/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thugs rnamatsha1)grol/ /grags pa khams gsum kun du gang 7/ /brgya byin mi yi dbang po dang / /klu 11rnams la sogs kun gyis mchod/ /de bzhin gshegs pas mig zad dang / /skye mtha' rab dben mkhyen lags na/ /ci slad 'dzum pa ston par mdzad/ /sangs rgyas sras ni tshad med pa12/ /'khor 'dir thams cad rab tu 'dus/ /sangs rgyas gsung las skyes pa dang / /chos las sprul te gang byung 1 ba/ /thams cad bcom ldan spyan sngar mchis/ /gus pas thal mo rab sbyar lags/ /'khor 'dus de dag slad du ni/ /'od zer rgyu rkyen 'di zhu lags/ /de bzhin gshegs pas mig nyid ni/ /stong zhing 48wa 609

bdag med mkhyen pas na/ /khyim na gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /thams cad las ni yang dag 'dasanyu)/ /de bzhin gshegs pas5)chos rnams ni/ /bye brag med cing mnyam mkhyen pas(gu/ /bcom ldan dgongs pasarab mkhyen gyidu/ /rdzu 'phrul dag gis gzigs ma lags⑥/ /bcom ldan mig la7bdag med mkhyen/ /ngo bo nyid stong 'gro 'ong med/ /rnam dag mkhyen pa tshad masamachis/ /ci slad 'dzum pa ston par mdzad// //3)bam po gsum pa / de bzhin gshegs pa skye mtha' rab zad51pa/ /thugs rje chen pos 'jig rten kun skyob mdzad/ /chos rje mchog gyur mi yi gtsor gyur pa/ /ci slad 'dzum pa bstanasngonamadzad bshad du gsol/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po tshad ma mchis/ /gzhan yang lha tshogs gzi byin che ba rnams / /mkha' la gdugs ni dam pa dag kyang thogs/ /sa chen 'di ni rab tu g.yos par gyur/ /gang zhig sngon ni de bzhin gshegs pa las/ /yun ring dge ba'i chos ni gang bsgrubs pa/ /hunyemanyam par dga' mdzad thugs rjesachen po'i gtso/ /ci slad 'dzum pa bstan mdzad bshad du gsol/ /gang zhig sngon ni sangs rgyas rab mchod nasal/ /chos 'di thos nas dga' ba rab skyesalgepas//'dren pa rab mchog mi yi gtsor gyur pa/ /ci slad 'dzum pa bstan mdzad bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan gsung ni mang po dga' mdzad pas/ /bya rgyal ngang pa bzhin nyu du dbyangs rab snyan/ /sgra snyan tshad med rang gi ngang gis 'byung ske/ /ci slad 'od zer 'di bkye bshad du gsol/ /tshigs bcad bye ba tshad ma mchis pa yis/ /rjes 'thunas(snyegasung gi bsngags 37pa brjod gyur cing5) /ku ༄ 1ci ra yi sgra zhu skad mchog ldan pa/ /ci slad 'od zer bkye ba bshad du gsol//48wa 610

'brug sgra zab mos7chos ni bstan57pa'i sgral/ /'jig rten brgya stong dpag med grags gyur pa/ /thugs rjes tshig rtsubatso)yang na 'jam ston pa/ /ci slad 'od zer gser gyi kha dog bkyephya/ /skye dang mi skye zad dang mi zad mkhyen/ /mig nyid bral zhing 'gro 'ong med par rtogasal/ /'jig rten snang mdzad bdud rtsi'i mchog gyur pani/ /ci slad 'od zer gser gyi kha dog bkye/ /mig gi byung59tshob rtag tu stong dben dang / /'gro 'ong ma mchis gnas pa ma mchis dang / /smig rgyu chu bur lta bur rab mkhyen pa/ /rgyu rkyen gang gi slad du 'dzum bstanatshwa ༵lags/ /de bzhin rna ba sna lce lus dang yid/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya711chos rnams nas/ /sgra dang ming la sogs pa'i bar du yang / /thams cad de bzhin du ninerig par bgyi(nye/ /rdo rje rtag pa'i sku dang mi 'jig sku/ /mtshan mchog brgya stong dag ni phun sum tshogs/ /sku la 'khrul 'khor mi mnga' g.yo mdzad pa//rgyu rkyen gang slad 'dzum pa bshad du gsol/ /byin pa zlum zhing zhabs kyi rtingasamapa ring7/ / phyal gyi mtshan ma mi gda' seng ge 'dra/ /lte ba shin tu zab cing kod7rgyas pa/ /rgyu rkyen gang slad 'dzum mdzad bshad du gsol/ /gser sku rnam dag rdul dang dri ma spangs/ /ba spu re re kha dog mthon 16mthing ldan/ /g.yas su 'khyil cing5) spos kyi ngad ldang ba(1/ /rgyu rkyen gang slad 'dzum mdzad bshad du gsol/ /sku mchog dam pa yongs rdzogs rtag gnas pa/ /dper na n+ya gro dha yi5nyeshing rgyal bzhin/ /yon tan thams cad kyis ni rab tu brgyan/ /gsung dbyangs dag gis 'khor ni dga' bar mdzad/ /dpung pa zlum zhing phrag pa stugatsol mdzes/ /gtsug tor yongs rdzogs g.yas su 'khyil bar gda'/ /zhing ni brgya stong dpag med rgyu bar mdzad/ /sems can log dang yang dag 40wa 611

lam ston mdzad/ /tshems7dkar dri mi mnga' bas dung dang 'dra/ /ljags mtshan srid ring zhal ni kun du khebs/ /'gram pa seng gi⑧'dra zhing shangs nisnyematho / /thams cad thabs dang rnam dag thugs las skyes/ /ud pa la yi bsung〈peni zhal nas 'byung / /tsan dan dri dag sku ni kun du khyab/ /sngon ni byams pa57rgya cher bsgoms pas na④/ /rnam dag mos pa rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'isnyizhabs mthil shinashetu mnyam/ /sa la reg kyang rdul ni gos mi 'gyur/ /gom pa boseng ge glang po che 'dra bas/ /'jig rten thams cad las57ni yang dag 'das/ /'khor lo rtsibs stong mtshan gyis mdzesalgepar brgyan/ /khyad 'phags 'od zer dag ni rab 8tu gsal/ /dge ba dag gis skye dgu༄phan 'dogs pas8/ /gang gis mthong ba dang ba rab tu skye/ /sor gcig 'od zer brgya stong rab bkye nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni dpag med snang bar mdzad/ /sngon ni dge sbyong mang po rab bsgrubs pas/ /mtshan gyi bkod pa sna tshogs 'di brnyes lags/ /gzugs sku yongs rdzogs dpe zla yong ma mchis / /zhal mtshan rab mdzes shin tu khyad par 'phags/ /rdzu 'phrul dag gis 'jig rten phan 'dogs pa/ /ci slad 'dzum pa bstan mdzad bshad du gsol / /byin pa ri dgas7)e na〈nyeya dang 'dra/ /sku dbyibs mi rgya0 seng ge ji lta bzhin/ /'jig rten byung nas 'jigamanyarten snang mdzad pa/ /ci slad 'dzum pa bstan mdzad bshad du gsol/ /cang shes bzhin du mtshan sbas rdul mi mnga' / /phyag mthil mnyam rgyas phyag ni pus mo 'das/ /mi yi seng ge ngo mtshar khyad par 'phags/ /ci slad 'dzum pa bstan mdzad bshad du gsol/ /sku las〈 gye'od zer dpag med rab 'gyedake cingatshu ste/ kha dog gya nom rab zhi rtag 48—612

gsal ba①/ /rnam dag thugs ni rtag tu rgyun mi 'chad/ /mdo sde tshad med pa dag ston par mdzad/ /rtag dang chad pa dag la gnas pa yis/ /de 'dra'i chos ni ②bsgrub ①par 'gyur ma lags/ /gang gis mthar lta rnams ni rab spangs nadu/ /bcom ldan rnam dag sku ni myur thob 'gyur/ /lha rnga 'brug sgrar+sā)gsung ni kun grags shing / /ka lan dkyika'i dbyangs snyan rab tu gsal/ /lha yi glu sgra brgya stong mngasaldan pa/ /ci slad 'od zer bkye ba bshad du gsol//'dren pas gsung gcigashetu ni chos bstan pas/ /'chal pa'i tshul khrims can dag rgyun yang bcad/ /de bzhin gshegs pas dbyangs rab gang gsungs03 pa/ /de kun zab cing ngo mtshar chos lags so/ /khyu mchog smin mtshams 'od zer rab bkye bas/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni brgya stong gsal bar mdzad/ /spyan mchog dag ni kha dogatshwanyemathon mthingatso'adra/ /gtsug tor mtshan ni mkha' yi7)lhas mi mthong ske/ /tshems dkar gtamasalgepa bzhi bcu dag dang ldan/ /dper na rin chen chu shel dag dang mtshungs/ /dge ba'i phrin nyugelas tshad med dag lasapha7skyes//ci slad 'dzum pa bstan mdzad bshad du gsol/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yon tan rdzogs pa'i sku/ /kha dog dam pa dpag med phun tshogs shing / /'od zer rnam dag ngo mtshar rab bkye ba/ /ci slad 'dzum pa bstan mdzad bshad du gsol/ /thugs rje chen po mchog rgyal rkang gnyis gtso/ /sems can yang dag bsam pa thugs su chud/ /thogs pa ma mchis spobs pa mchog brnyes hu)pa/ /ci slad 'dzum pa bstan mdzad bshad du gsol/ /de bzhin gshegs pas pha rol rab hurtebyon pas/ /rig pa gsum dang mngon shes drug phun tshogs/ /rnam dgas(6'od zer dpag med ston mdzad pa/ /ci slad 'dzum pa bstan mdzad bshad du 40wa 613

gsol / /bcom ldan sngon ni bskal pa dpag med snyed/ /bcom ldan brgya stong snyed la mchod pa mdzad/ /de 'dra'i rgyu 'bras chab ni mi 'tshal ba/ /ci slad 'dzum pa bstan mdzad bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan sngon ni bskal pa dpag med snyed/ /ting 'dzin mchog rnamasatul ni rab bzhugasalgepas/ /mig gi skye mtha' zad pa'i mtha' mkhyen na/ /ci slad 'dzum pa bstan mdzad bshad dushegasol / /'das pa dang7ni ma 'ongs da ltar dus/ /'dren pas de dag kun ni rab tu mkhyen/ /rnam dag mkhyen pa thogs med bsam mi khyab/ /ci slad 'dzum pa bstan mdzad bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 'khor mang po'i mdun du phyag gser gyi kha dog lta bu brkyang steyi/ zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa'i spyi bo la bzhag57nas tshigs su bcad de'ubaka' stsal pa/ gzhon nu shin tu legs par nyon/ /ngas ni deng 'dir byang chub chosal/ /'od zer rab tu ston pa'i mdo/ /khyod la shin tu yongs gtad kyis0/ /ma 'ongs tha ma dus ngan tshe/ /chos ni rnam par 'jig pa5)na/ /khyod kyis sems can rnams la ni/ /rab tu phye nas bshad par gyis/ /ngas ni sangs rgyas spyan dag gis/ /ma 'ongs tha ma nyunyedus kyi tshe/ /shin tu zab cing gya nom pa'i/ /mdo sde dam pa 'di dag la/ /gang mos nyugegang ni mi mos pa/ /thams cad kun kyang gzigs shing mkhyen / /sems can dag ni gang zhig gis/ /byang chub lam ni rab tshol ba/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas rjes dran zhing / /mdo sde 'di ni gzungakhebar gyis/ /gang zhig dad pa skorab 'jig cing / /'du 'dzi la ni mos 'gyur dang / /nyin mtshan gnyid la gang dga' ba/ /mdo sde 'di la mos mi 'gyur/ /nga yi bstan pa dag las〈deni/ /rab tu byung bar gyur nas kyang / /mya ngan 'das 48—614

pa'i chos dag la/ /mos pa dag ni mi skye ba/ /skyes bu blun po de dag ni/ /dad pas byin pa chud gzonatu'agyur/ /'dus byas rnams kyisachos dag la/ /nyes dmigs mang bar thos kyang ni/ /'jig rten dag la mngon zhen nas/ /'jigasalgepa dag ni mi skye ba/ /skyes bu blun po de dag ni/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis smod par 'gyur/ /chos gos dag ni bgos gyur kyang / /de la shes rab ci yang med/ /thub pas legs par gsungs pa yi/ /yang dag bka'༄ni gang yin pa/ /shes pa med pas thos gyur na/ /yid ches lenatso par mi 'gyur te/ /skyes bu blun po de dag dang / /lhan cig gnas par mi bya'o/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i chos 'di dag /gal te thos par gyur nas kyang / /rab tu dga' zhing mos pa yis/ /sems kyang skye bar mi 'gyur ba/ /de 'dra'i gang zag dag la7ni/ /ngas ni rab tu smod par byed/ /mistso)lus thob par gyur mod kyang / /de ni don med chud zos yin/ /gal te shin tu zab pa'i chos/ /'di dag thos par gyur nas5)ni/ /rab tu dga' zhing mos pa yinya sems ni rab tu skye 'gyur ba/ /de 'dra'i gang zag de dag ni/ /sngon chad sangs rgyas phrad pas na/ /gdon mi za ba kho nar ni/ /bla med byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /skyes bu blun po gang dag cigatso /lta ba ngan pasamurab smasamatshanas/ /shes rab srog ni gcod byed pa/ /byang chub yongs su spong bar 'gyur/ /de lta bas na mi dge ba'i/ /bshes gnyen dag ni rab spangs nas/ /blo ldan mkhas pa dag la ni/ /bstenarwanyecing gus pa bskyed par bya/ /'jig rten〈shedag ni thams cad na / /nyes dmigs tshad med gang yod dngas36/ /sems can ngan song gsum por ni/ /rtag tu bying〈 )bar gang byed pa/ /thams cad gti mug rmongs pa yi/ /40wa 615

rgyu dang rkyen las byung bas na①/ /nyon mongs rjesakhusu 'jug byed cing / /rang dbang dag ni 'thobanyemi 'gyur/ /yang dag chos ni spong byed cing / /chos ma yin pa spyod par7byed/ /de lta bas na rmongs pa yi/ /skyes bu dman pa spang bar bya/ /ji ltar kha lo sgyur ba yisaX/ /rang gi srog shing bcag⑧pa bzhin/ /mi dgephrolas ni byas pas na/ /sems can dmyal bar skye bar 'gyur/ /kha nas tshig ngan phyung nas ni/ /rtag tu bdag la gnod byed pa/ /ji ltar sta rerwanyerno thogs nas(rte/ /rang gi lus ni gcod byed 'dra/ /chos rnams rgyu dang rkyen dag gis/ /byas pa'i las hu)kyi rjes su ni/ /rnam smin myong ba skyabs med par/ /de ltar khong du ma chud pas/ /'jig rten drang srong la bstenasgosanas/ /dge ba'i grogs po yin snyam 8sems/ /de nas rang nyid 'di snyam du/ /stong pa nyid ni gang bsgom 9pa/ /'dus ma byas ni rtogs snyam nas/ /chad par lta ba skyed par byed/ /lus ni snod chag pa dang 'dra/ /sems kyang rjes su 'gag gyur zhes/ /phal cher kyal pa'itshwa)tshig dag la/ /mos pa nyid du rab 'gyur zhing —/ /'di la mngon par zhen pas na/ /phan pa'i don ni ci yang med/ /gal te sbrul ni gdug pa yis/ /gnod pa dag ni rab byas kyang / /nam yang skye dgurwa/mang po rnams/ /ngan 'gro dag tu ltung mi byed(3 / /blun po gang zhig chos ston pa/ /dge ba'i gistom ba 'jig byed pas/ /skye dgu du rtemang po tshad med snyed / /sems can dmyal bar nyung bar byed/ /khyed la〈nyesogs pa 'khor 'dus pa/ /'di lta bur ni lta zhu/bar gyis/ /deng 'dir nga yi spyan sngar ni/ /zla 'od gzhon nu gang 'dug shusnyepa/ /'dis ni sngon chad 'das pa yi/ /sangs rgyas dag ni bcom ldan 'das/ /tshad med gang gā'i5)klung bye snyed/ /48wa 616

mchod pa rim gronyerab byas shing / /shin tu brtanasngon/par yongs bsgoms minas//bla med ye shes btsal bas na/ /srid pa dag ni thams cad la/ /sems kyis gnas pa ci yang med/ /mig gi skye mtha' gtan du ni/ /rnam par dag par9)shes pas na/ /spros pa dag ni yongs spangs nas/ /mngon par zhen57pa ci yang med/ /sems can dag ni tshad med 'kha/ /phan pa dag ni bya ba'i phyir/ /bla med 'od zer ston pa yi/ /mdo sde dag ni ston par byed/ /skyes bu blun po gang yin pa/ /chos 'di slob par mi nus pas/ /rnal 'byor bsgomashepa dag la ni/ /skyon nyid du yang ltakhubar byed/ /de lta bas na blun po dag /thag ring por7ni yongs spangs nas/ /de dag la ni bstan mi bya/kā/ /de yi chos kyang mi bslab bo8/ /skyes bu blun po gang yin pa/ /rtsodatshwanyepa'i smra la mos pas na/ /rtsod smra med pa'i spyod pa la/ /nan tan bsgrub05par mi nus pas/ /skyes bu de dag rnams la ni/ /tshul bzhin sems ni ci yang med/ /de lta bas na de dag la/ /bsnyen bkur mi bya bsngags mi brjod/ /skyes bu blun po gang yin pa/ /le lo snyom las la gnas pas/ /rtag tu lus dang ngag yid kyi/ /mi dge las ni spyodatshwanyepas na/ /de la tshul khrims dag pa dang / /shes rab mang thos ci yang med/ /rtag tu 'dod pa'i yul sems shing / /'du 'dzi dag la mos par byed/ /khyed hu)kyis 'di ltar blun po de/ /rigs dang rus dang lus kyang0 ni/ / bodaman pa yin par rab tu ltos/ /khong khro bka' blo mi bde zhing / /byad bzhin dag ni mi sdug la rta/ /gal te dge ba'i gnas skyes kyang ske/ /lus ni rtag tu ma rabs 'gyur/ /bdag tu 'du shes la zhen pas/ /yang dag don la rmongs par 'gyur/ /blo gros dag dang5)mi ldan pas/ /tshig 48—617

gi bye brag 'byed mi nus/ /rang bzhin stong pa'i chos thos kyang / /de la mos pa skyed 1mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das/ /yun ring po nas 'jig rten pa'i/ /tshig gi naspros pa gang yin pa/ /thams cad rab tu spangs pa yin/ /so so'i skye bos 'di dag la/ /shin tu zhen cing chags pas na ske/ /ji srid 'tsho ba'i cabar du yang / /rtogs shing 5khong du chud mi 'gyur/ /tshul khrims bsngags pa rjod 6byed kyang / /tshangs par spyod pa sgrubs mi byed/ /kha nas chos ni ston byed kyang / /lus kyis chos min spyod par byed/ /rang gis 'dul ba ston byed kyang / /rtag tu 'dul min spyod par byed/ /sangs rgyas slob ma dag la ni/ /kha dog bsgyur 8ba'i gos gyon gsungs/ /'chal pa'i tshul khrims can dag gis/ /gos 'di 9rab tu bgos gyur kyang / /nga rgyal dang tshoni bag med pa'i/ /sems ni rab tu 'phel bar byed/ /dad pas byin pa ci zos pa / /thu 11lum 'bar ba mid pa 12'dra/ /de ltar khyim gyi gnas spangs nya nas/ /'dod pa lnga yi bde ba'ang med/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas chos dag la/ /mchog gi bde ba ma thob nas/ /spyod pa 'dren ma ngamos byed pasas/ /mtha' gnyis dag ni spong mi 'gyur/ /yid kyi mos pa ji snyed pa/ /thams cad kyang ni dag 16mi 'gyur/ /de 'dra'i gang zag blun po ni/ /'khor mang nang du gnas gyur kyang 1 / /dper na ji ltar wa skyes dag18 /seng ge'i khyur ni zhugs pa bzhinam/ /de ltar rab tu zhi ba yi/ /chos ni yang dag bstan 19byas kyang / / de bzhin 2 nyid dang stong pa'i don/ /rtogs 2 shing khong du ma chud pas/ /'khor mang dag la bstan bsngags kyang / /khengs pa'i sems ni skyed na par byed / /ston pa chen po mi dran pas/ /ngo tsha dman pa'i sems kyang med/ /mi 40wa 618

gtsang dngos po len byed kyang / /yid bzhin nor bu thob pa bzhin/ /shin tu dga' bas 'dzin byed pas11/ /sems kyis chungs zad gtong mi byed/ /'di lta bu yi ma rabs dag /khyim nas rab tu byung nas ni/ /spyod lam cadag kyang srung ba 55dang / /chos gos lhung bzed 'dzin byed kyang / /cha byad tsam dang ldan pas na/ /yang dag shes rab ci yang med/ /kha spu dag ni bregs 6gyur kyang ske/ /sdig pa'i sems ni mi spong zhing / /dge sbyong ma yin pa yi chos/ /log lta dag ri7)tu lhung 78)9)gyur na/ /rab dben mya ngan 'das pa'i lam de dag rab tu nyams par 'gyur/ /dge sbyong mngon 1 du 11bya ba yi/ /'bras bu dag kyang 'thob /2mi 'gyur/ /ma rig nyon mongs rnams kyang ni/ /rdul tsam nyams par mi 'gyur ro/ /grong khyer dag 1 tu rnam rgyu zhing / /rang nyid dben pa'i bsngags thubarjod kyang / /skyes bu blun po blo med pas/ /yang dag bgrod pa mashes mi 'gyur/ /sems kyi 'dun pa ci yod pa/ /de dag thams cad mi dge yin/ /rnyed pa 'dod pa'i pargyu yi phyir/ /dgon pa dag na gnas byed kyi/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i 1 7yang dag rgyu/ /bsgrub 1 pa'i phyir ni ma yin no/ /rmugs dang gnyid 36la rab tu dga' rme/ /lus ni ji ltar bde snyam nas/ /rtag tu de lta'i dngos 21po dag /sgrub 22pa la ni mos par byed/ /dgon pa'i gnas ni de dag tu/ /lo ni mang por gnas byed kyang / /phyin log lta bar gyur pa'i phyir/ /mya ngan 'das lam stor bas 2lhan/ / nams kyang 2 dge sbyong lam dag gi 5/ /'bras bu dag ni thob mi 'gyur/ /yang dag lta ba rab nyams shing / /tshul khrims dag dang 'gal byas pas/ /gos bzang dag gis lus brgyan pa lho/ /de la shin tu sred par 'gyur/ /'dod pa'i bde ba 2 rnams la ni/ /rtag tu sred 40wa 619

pa skyed par0)byed/ /gal te grong khyer zhugs na yang / /nga rgyal mtshan ma ston byed cing / /lus kyi las ni mi srung bas/ /spyod lam dag lasheganas mi byed/ /res 'ga' grong khyer zhugs nas ni/ /rgyu tshe rang nyid 'di skad du/ /dgon pa'i gnas ni de dag na / /ri phug dag ni gang yodasrepa/ /khyed rnams 'di ltar shes par gyis/ /de ni bdag gisnyiganas yin te/ / mtho dma'aphuran par ltas47ba dang / /'gro gom tshul la gnas so zhes/ /tha dad mtshan ma'i tshig brjod de/ /dgra bcom pa yi rtags bstan pasasnyu/ /khyim pa dag ni ji snyed pa/ /phan tshun du ni 'di skad du/ /dgon pa'i dge slong gang yin pa/ /yang dag 'phags pa yin zhes zer/ /res 'ga' dgon pa de dag na/ /gnas par gyur pa de yi tshe/ /gal te gzhan dag 'ongs gyur na/ /'di lta bur ni ston par byed/ /bdag ni dgon gnas 'di dag tu/ /nyin mtshan 'chag⑩par byed ce hu1'am/ /yang na rtswa 'jam bting〈rtenas ni/ /'dir ni 'dug par byed ces zer/ /res 'ga' grong khyer zhugs gyur nas/ /khyim pa'i〈nyeder ni phyin pa'i tshe/ /g.yo sgyus nyu༄nan tan 'di skad du/ /bde 'am zhes ni 'dri bar byed/ /'jig rten pa yi 'du 'dzi'i gtam/ /rgyal po chom rkun la7sogs pa'isnyi/ /sna tshogs dag ni rjod 7par byed/ /res 'ga' chags pa'i sems dag gis/ /bud med rnams kyi mdun dag tu/ /thabs ni rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /rang gi yon tan rjod nyushepar byed/ /bdag ni 'jig rten thams cad kyi/ /bsod nams zhing ni chen po //byed/ /bdag ni rgyal thabs rab spangs nas/ /rab tu byung nas lam sgom nu noyin/ /btsun mo dang ni sras (7rnams kyang / /mtho ris skyes par nirtegyur ces zer/ /de dag de skad thos nas ni/ /shin tu gus pa 40wa 620

rangatubaskyed de/ /gos〈zas dang nim btung ba dag④ /sna tshogs sbyar nas mchod par byed/ /btsun pas thugs rjer〈perab dgongs shing / /bdag cagam༄6)thad du yang gshegs7zer/ /ro zhim dag la zhenas chags shing / /nyes dmigs rnams ni mi shes pas/ /bdud kyis blagasapo)kyang rnyed lha ci'agyur te17/ /rus32sbal rgya mos zin pa 'dra/ /dgon par gnas pa dag la yang / /rnyed pa dag gis snyems〈nyepar byed/ /dge slong brtson 'grus can dag la/ /brnyasatshabashing tsheskur pa 'debs par byed/ /rnyed dang grags pas sems rmongs pas yang nas yang du zhen pa skyedatunye/ /lus ni yongs su gso ba'i phyir/ /rtag tu g.yo sgyu spyod pas na/ /lus dang ngag gi mi dgerwa)las/ /yang nas yang du 'phel bar byed/ /gal te sbyin bdag dad pa yis/ / dad pa'iphu )sems kyis mchod na yang / /le lo snyom5)las dbang gis ni/ /de yi bsod nams 'brim bar byed / /skyes bu blun po de dag ni/ /rtag tu mi dge dro ci 'dod bskyed pas byu/ /stong pa nyid kyi nyechos 'di la/ /rjes 'thun 39bzod sems 'thob 3 tshomi 'gyur/ /gang dag nga yi bstan pa las(nye/ /nyes dmigs de dag rab spangs nas/ /nan tan bag yod sgrub byed na/ /chos 'di thos par 29dka' mi 'gyur/ /rnyed pa dang ni mi rnyed dang / /bstodamanye smad sdug bsngal bde lamalhasogs/ /'jig rten chos kyis mi g.yos pas/ /chos 'di thobarmu par dka' mi 'gyur/ /lus la mi gtsang 'du shesamanyedang / /phung po rma yi5ge'adu shes dang / /zas ni rma bskus 'du shes pa/ /chos 'di thob par59dka' mi 'gyur/ /gos bzangasam tshodag ni thob gyur kyang / /dregasamu)pa dag ni57mi skyed cing )/ /ngo tsha dgab nya pa'i phyir gyon pa/ /chos 'di thob par risnyedaka' mi 'gyur/ /gzugs dang 40wa 621

stobs ni mi snyems shing nya / /zas la chags pa med pa dang / /srog gnasashephyir ni gang za ba/ /chos 'di thob paras dka' mi 'gyur/ /sredakyipa rnams ni stong shes nas/ /'dod pa dag la blang dor med/ /rtag tu stong dben gang spyod pa/ /chos 'di thob par ge dka' mi 'gyur/ /dpag tshad gcig 'das ri khrod du/ /gcig pu 'dug nas mnyam bzhag50cing / /'dus byas bdag med gang rtogs 7 pa/ /chos 'di thob par(byedaka' mi 'gyur/ /mishezad skye ba'i mtha' dag dang / /mig 'jug mtshan nyid rtogs byed cing / /migatsogatsang lam ni rab sgrub 11pa/ /chos 'di thob par dka' mi 'gyur/ /rna ba sna lce lus dang yid/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya nas/ /sgra dang ming gi bar du yang / /thams cad kun kyang de bzhin no/ /de bzhin ma 'ongs dus kyi tshe/ /dge slong dag ni tshad med snyed/ /brtson pa dang ni le lo can/ /thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /dge dang mi dge'i grogs po dag /sgrubasngo)pa dang ni mi sgrubatsopa / /yid ches pa dang yid mi ches/ /thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /dge dang mi dge'i grogs po dag / mig zad gelam ni gang yin pa/ /sgrub 8pa dang ni mi sgrub 7pa/ /thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /gang zhig byang chub rab mos shing / /zla gcig 3 gnyis gsum 'das nas ni/ /dus gzhan phyir ni gang ldog 32pa/ /thams cad de bzhin shes par gyis/ /gang zhig chos 'di thos gyur nas/ /mos pa'i sems ni gang bskyed 3)pa/ /gal te nyams par gyur na yang / /slar ni dad pa thob par 'gyur/ /gang zhig chos 'di thos (2 gyur nas/ /bag med spong bar mi byed pa nya/ /mdo 'di sangs rgyas dka'amanyem〈nyeyin / /de snyam du ni sems par 'gyur/ /gang zhig chos 'di thos gyur nas/ /48—622

bdud kyis yongs su gang bzung ba/ /dang po dad pa tsho)skyes gyur kyang / /phyis ni rab tu spong bar 'gyur/ /gang zhig chos la ma mos pa/ /mi bden tshanagrags dang rnyed pa tshol/ /grong khyer grong rdal gerab rgyu zhing / /gzungs sgo rnams dang ni ting 'dzin dang / /kun 'dzin 'od zer bsngags chosabarjod kyang 6)/ /de yis yang dag rtogs57mi 'gyur/ /'dod pa lnga pos bcings pa dang / /'jig rten las ni〈'dod tshol ba/ /brjod pa dag ni rtogs byed pas/ /stong nyid sgom497la skur pa 'debs/ /dran dang shes rab sems med pas11/ /tshe tshad rab /2tu don med 'das/ /blun po 3)stong pa'i chos spong bathu/ /de ni tshul khrims bgegs 8byas pas/ /mnar med dag 9tu ltung bar 'gyur/ / nam yang 1 mtho ris yonganyemi skye/ /gang gis skad cig gcig la ni/ /mchod rten stong ni byas pa bas/ /gang gis mdo sde 'di thos nas/ /tshig //bzhi tshigs bcad gcig 'dzin 'phags/ /me tog phreng nu )ba brgya stong dag /sangs rgyas mchod rten mchod pa bas/ /gang gis tsho lhamado sde 'di thos nas/ /tshig 2bzhi tshigs bcad sems pa 'phags/ /gang gis rin chen mchod rten dag /gang gā'i 22bye snyed byas pa bas/ /gang gis tha na skad cig tsam/ /mdo sde 'di sems khyad par 'phags/ /sangs rgyas zhing ni 'bum phrag brgya/ /me tog gtor nas mchod pa bas(ste/ /zhuge(lhagang ni tshogis tha na skad cig 28tsam/ /mdo sde 'di sems khyad par 'phags/ /chos gos 'bum phrag brgya mang po/ /sangs rgyas rnams la phul ba bas rje/ /gang gis tha na skad cig tsam/ /mdo sde 'di sems khyad par 'phags / /sangs rgyas spyan ni rnam dag 'phags/ /mi mkhyen mi gzigs gang yang med/ /gang gis mdo sde 'di mos na/ /sangs rgyas spyan ni thob par 40wa 623

'gyur / /'das pa'i bskal pa grangs med tshe/ /sangs rgyas mar me mdzad pa byung ske/ /nga ni bram ze'i tsho) khye burasho gyur/ /me tog thogs nas mchod pa byas/ /shākyatshabathub pa zhes bya ba/ /byang chub snying po la 'dug nas/ /mdo sde 'di ni ston 'gyur zhes/ /nga la byang chub lung yang bstanadu/ /khyod ni de tshe gzhon nur gyur/ /nga 5)lung bstan pa 6)thos gyur nas/ /dga' zhing dang ba'i sems bskyed de/ /thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad du/ /gal te bram ze'i⑧khye'udu 'di ni6)la/ /mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas 'itshe/ /bdag ni de yi grogs gyur nas / /mya ngan 'das pa'i 'og tu yang / /chos kyi sde snodatshwanyerab 'dzin cing / /srung hu bar shog ces smon lam btab/ /sangs rgyas mar me mdzad de yis/ /'od zer ston pa'i mdo 'di ni/ /ji skad gsungs〈nyebazhin de yi tshe/ /bram ze'i khye'u dang gzhon nu 8gnyis/ /legs 8par mnyan7cing yongs su bzung / /nga sngon 'das pa'i sna snadus kyi tshe/ /me tog ud pa la dag gis(nye/ /sangs rgyas de la mchod pa byas/ /de tshe khyod kyang der 'dug ste/ /'di skad du ni smon lam btab/ /nga yi bstan pa tha ma la/ /mdo sde 'di ni rab bzung nas/ /rgya cher ston par shog ces smras/ /gang gis chos 'di thos gyur nas/ /zhe snang sems ni mi skyed lha par/ /gzung ri )'dzin klog cing gang 'don pa/ /de ni skyes bu dam pa yin/ /khyod kyis sa1ma 'ongs dus kyi tshe/ /thos dka'i chos 'di rab bzung nas32/ /sems can dag la don gyi tshul/ /rgya cher dbye zhing bstan par bya/ /ngas kyang 'das pa'i dus kyi tshe/ /yang dag chos ni nub pa na/ /'od zer ston da pa'i mdo 'di ni/ /sems can dag la rgya cher bstan/ /blun pos nan ru tan mi sgrub du pas/ /'di la skur pa〈 9'debs par byed/ /ngas ni 40wa 624

de skad thos gyur kyangatu/ /zhe sdang dag ni skyedamo mi byed/ /ngas rinani rtag tu bzod bsgomasalgenas/ /'jig rten rnams la phan 'dogs byed/ /bzod pa'i stobs ni rdzogs pas na/ /mtshan dang dpesabyad dag gis brgyan/ /gzhon nu khyod kyis sangs rgyas sku/ /gya rnam yongs su rdzogs gyur cing76)/ /gser gyi kha dog rnam dag 'phags/ /bzod pa'i stobs las byung mebar ltos/ /nga yi zhabs ni sa reg nas/ /zhing ni tshad medashegayo byed kyang / /sems can rnams ni mi ltung ba/ / thams cadamatshabazod pa'i stobs las nyi skyes32/ /nga yi spu khung gcig nas7ni/ /'od zer brgya stong rab bkye nas/ /thams cad gsal bar gang byed pa/ /thams cad bzod mchog stobs las byung / /srin po bzhin du 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /srog chags gzi byin lo'aphrog byed pa/ /nga la rtag tu gus pa yang / /thams cad bzod mchog stobs las byung / /nga yi 'khor ni ji snyed pa/ /sems ni rab tu dul gyur nas/ /de bzhin gshegs la7gus pa yang / /thams cad bzod mchog stobs las byung / /rol mo'i sgra ni brgya stong dag /'khor 'dus chen po'i nang dag tu/ /sangs rgyas yon tan bsngags brjod pa/ /thams cad bzod mchog stobs las byung / /klu yi rgyal po brgya stong dag /rab tu gdug cing 'jigs rung ba/ /sangs rgyas mthong na dga' ba yangapo / /thams cad bzod mchog stobs las byung / /srin po gnod sbyin las shesogs pas/ /me tog phreng zhu rdzob brgya stong thogs/ /'ongs nas nga la mchod byed pa/ /thams cad bzod mchog stobs las byung / /zhing ni brgya nyestong tshad med par/ /bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /nga yi yon tan bsngags pa yang / /thams cad bzod mchog stobs las byung / /48—625

lto 'phye 1dang ni lus srul po/ /brgya stong dag ni 'dus gyur nas/ /me tog gtor nas nga mchod pa/ /thams cad bzod mchog stobs las byung / /gnod sbyin rgyal po la nasogs pa/ /bye ba brgya phrag drug cu rnams/ /'ongs nas nga la gang mchod pa/ /thams cad bzod mchog stobs las byung / /gzhan yang klu yi rgyal po ni/ /ma na ba ga la sogs pas/ /mu tig dmar pos nga mchod pa/ /thams cad bzod mchog stobs las byung / /du mu ru dang shi khyi ba'i(ge/ /brgya stong snyed ni 'dus gyur nas/ /rol mo dag gis nga mchod pa/ /thams cad bzod mchog stobs las byung / /lto 'phye dang ni lus srul po/ /brgya stong snyed ni 'dus gyur nas/ /me tog 4spos kyis nga mchod pa/ /thams cad bzod mchog stobs las byung / /sa chen 'dzin pa klu yi rgyal/ /lus phyed 2dag ni rab bstan nenas/ /thal sbyar nga la gus pa 75yang / /thams cad bzod mchog stobs las byung / /lus med sgra gcan zin 8la sogs/ /bye ba phrag spuni brgya stong rnams/ /dang ba'i sems kyis nga mchod pa/ /thams cad bzod mchog stobs las byung / /gzhon nu khyod kyis 'di ltar ltos/ /sangs rgyas 'od zer gang reg pa/ /sdug bsngal bral nas bde thob pa/ /thams cad bzod mchog stobs las byung / /sa 1 mu ta dang rlung gi lha/ /brgya stong nam mkha' 31gang bar 12ni/ /spos kyi 1nyechar phab 〉nga mchod pa/ /thams cad bzod mchog stobs las byung / /lha yi 'khor ni brgya stong dag /lha yi me tog gtor mchod de / /srid spangs sangs rgyas sten dbyed pa/ /thams cad bzod mchog stobs las byung / /khyed 7kyis sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul dang / /sbyin dang tshul khrims sgra bsgrags nas1 / /thams cad kun du thos mdzad pa/ /bzod mchog stobs 40wa 626

las byung bar ltos/ /phung po khams kyi sgra dag dang / /bden pa bzhi yi sgra dag gis/① /thams cad kun ni〈go mdzad pa/ /thams cad bzod mchog stobs las byung / /nga yi rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis ni/ /mkha' las mig zad mtha' dgasredang / /rab zhi'i5gesgra ni thos gyur te/ /skye ba'i mtha' yang de bzhin no/ /nga yi rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis ni/ /mkha' las 6mig ni rgyu dang rkyen/ /de las skye yang〈'gro 'ong med/ /de skad du ni thos par 'gyur/ /nga yi rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis ni/ /mkha' las mig zhi rtogs byed na/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyang de las skyes/ /de skad du ni thos par 'gyur/ /nga yi rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis ni / /mkha' las dusamig zad mtha' zhi bas/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni de las skyes / /de skad du ni thos par 'gyur/ /nga yi rdzu 'phrul stobs 9kyis ni/ /mkha' las mig mtha' nyi norab zhi bas/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni de las skyes/ /de skad du ni thos par 'gyur/ /nga yi rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis ni/ /mkha' las 11mig skye mtha' zhi bas(3/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni de las skyes/ /de skad du ni thos par 'gyur/ /nga yi rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis ni/ /mkha' las mig 'jug rab zhi na/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni de las skyes/ /de skad du ni thos par 'gyur / /nga yi rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis ni/ /mkha' 12las mig ni saskye tshazhi bas/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni de las skyes/ /de skad du ni 17thos par 'gyur/ /nga yi rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis ni/ /mkha' las mig 1 dben rab zhi bas/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni de las skyes/ /de skad du ni thos par 'gyur/ /rna ba sna lce lus dang yid / /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya nas/ /sgra dang ming la sogs pa'i bar/ /thams cad kun kyang 3)de bzhin no/ /'dod sdang 19gti mug khong khro dang / /48—627

'chab 1dang phrag dog g.yo sgyu dang / /khengs dang nga rgyal la gsogs pa/ /rgya cher bshad 5pa'ang de bzhin no/ /de nas zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pas bde ltams)bu'i chos khyad par dus 'phags pa thos pas rab tu dga' bar gyur nas thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sang 7gi gdugs la bdag de bzhin gshegs pa dang dus/ 'khor mang po dang bcas par gdugs tshod la spyan 'dren na/ thugs brtse bar dgongs te bdag gis sbyar ba'i gdugs tshod gsol par ci gnang / /de skad ces gsol pa dang /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis 9cigazhon nu nyu rmede'i bsam pa rnam par dag pa dang /sems can tshad med pa rnams la yang phan pa mdzad 31par 'gyur bar thugs kyis mkhyen nas thugs brtse bar dgongs te cang mi gsung bsamanyeganang ngo / /de nas zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa stan 1snyelas langs nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag byas te/ lan gsum bskor ba byas nas/ rab tu dga' bas rang gi khyim du song ste/ rang gi 'khor dang bcas pa dang / lhasadang —/ klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / lto 'phye chen po skul 8sogs pas rgyal po'i khab kyi 1 grong khyer chen po'i hurtebazhi mdor dar gyi lding 3)khang bres te lding khang de yang shin tu mtho zhing rgya che la thams cad kun du khyab pa/gser gyi tsong tsong dra bar nu ribris pa/ nor bu rin po che'i phreng ba spyangs 37pa/seng ge'i ba dan sa dang / gser gyi phreng ba du gelu gu rgyud can 'bum phrag brgya stong sna tshogs kyis brgyan pari byu/ gzhan yang rin po che'i me tog kha dog khyad par du 25'phags pa'i phreng ba'i 2'phung po dag gcal tri du bkram mo/ /me tog tsam pa ka dang a ti mug ta na la 29sogs pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyi phreng sa )ba tshad 48wa 628

med 1grangs med pa yang rin bye —rtedhekhe snyeng —rte rngo gi wang ༵༵༵ —bye rdo sderdorngo /'khor 'dus pa thams cad kun tu 5khyab par sbyangs 3shing rgyan ladu bres so/ /gzhan yang de'i nang du khri stan rnams bshams nas/ rin po che'i spos phyi li 5ka dang / du ma tsa dang / tsan dan dang / gur gum rnam par dag cing yid 6dga' bar byed pa sna tshogs bsregs so/ /de bzhin du 7sbyar spos mchog dam pa sna tshogs kyang mchod pa'i yo byad du sbyar to/ /gzhan yang spos kyi chus lam srang rnams kun tu khyab par chag chag btab po/ /sa gzhi 8kun du me tog sna tshogs gcal thodu bkram mo/ /de'i tshe lha'i bu mo dang / lha ma yin gyi bu mo dang ske/ sgra gcan zin 7gyi bu mo grangs med tshad med pa 11yang rab tu dga' ba'i sems bskyed nas/ byang chub kyi rgyu mngon par bsgrub 12par 'dod pa'i phyir der 'ongs nas grong khyer chen po khyad par 1 du 'phags pa de rab tu brgyan to / / de nas 7zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa logrong khyer de kun du khyab par brgyan cing 17yongs su dag pa dang gdugs tshod la bab par rig nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das sems can rnams la sman par mdzad pa'i slad du grong khyer chen por gshegs su gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor mang po dang thabs cig 1 tu grong khyer du gshegs nas sgo'i them pa la zhabs bzhag ma thag 18tu grong khyer chen po de'i sa chen po yang rab tu g.yos par gyur/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'bum phrag brgya stong tshad med pa yang rab tu g.yos par gyur te/ de'i tshe long ba dag ni gzugs 19mthong bar gyur / sdug bsngal ba rnams ni bde ba thob par gyur/ 'on pa rnams ni 2 sgra thos par 'gyur/ byad bzhin mi sdug pa rnams ni byad bzhin bzang po thob 40wa 629

par gyur/ nor med pa rnams ni nor dang ldan par gyur/ bu med pa rnams ni bu yod par gyur/ gos med pa rnams ni gos thob 3)par gyur/ rin po che med pa rnams ni rin po che thob par gyur/ nye bshes med pa rnams ni nye bshes dang ldan par gyur/ lus kyi ②rgyan thams cad kyis phongs zhupa rnams ni lus kyi rgyan thams cad dang ldan par gyur torige/ /gzhan yang ngang pa dang /khrung khrung dang / ne tso dang / rma bya dang / ka ri ka lams)sogs pasabya'i tshogs mang po rnams de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba dang / rab tu dga' ba'i sems bskyed nas 7skra snyan cing 8)yid du 'ong ba pemachog dam pa gyur the )ste/gang gis sgra de dag nyu1thos pa / yang yid shin tu bde bar gyur to/ /gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pas kyi:rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis tsam pa ku'i ljon shing tshad med pa 1 snyed 15mngon par sprul pasal/ sems can brgya stong mang po rnams me togarwa snayongs su dag pa de dag dang / gzhan yang spos mchog dam pa thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mngon par gtor nyurtete mchod pa byas so/ /gzhan yang lha ma yin gyi bu mo dbang phyug thob pa brgya stong du ma mu tig dmar po dang / tsan dan gyi phye ma thogs nas de bzhin gshegs pa la rab tu dga' bas mngon par gtor to/ /lha ma yin mang po dang / gzhan yang lha mang po rnams rin po che'i gdugs gser dang / dngul 17gyis rab tu ri )brgyan (1pa thogs nas bar snang la 'dug ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i steng du khebs par g.yogs so/ /gzhan 2rteyang bcom ldan 'das kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis tsan dan tsho 2gyi ljon shing dngas(byu / gser gyi ljon shing dang /22 rin po che'i snod dang / gos la 39sogs pa'i ljon shing brgya stong 2 tshad med na dpag tu med pa sa/rin po che rnams kyis brgyan 40wa 630

pa / me tog dang / lo ma phun sum tshogs 3shing rgyas pa/ sems can tshad med pa'i snobasod nams kyi rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu thun mong du mngon par grub pa/ rlung gi ngad langs pa tsam gyisam spos mchog dam pa'i dris sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med pa rnams kun tu khyab par gang ba du mngon par sprul to/ /sems can brgya stong tshad med pa rnams kyis kyang dus gcig tu me tog thogs nas bcom ldan 'das la mngon par gtor to/ /de bzhin du 67sems can ma yin pa tshad med pa rnams kyang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis mngon par sprul pa sha stag go/ /gang dag ci dang ci smon 87pa de dag kyang rdzu 'phrul gyi dbang gis de dag gi 49)bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du re ba yongs su rdzogs par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das grong khyer du gshegs pa'i tshe 'khor 'dus pa thams cad nam mkha' la 3 khyad par du 11'phags pa'i sgra 12bsam gyis mi khyab par yang dag par ston pa'i sgra thos par gyur kyang de gang nas byung ba 1lhashes par yang ma gyur la〈stetshigs su bcad pa brgya stong du mas kyang chos rnams 1lhayang dag par bstan par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das ni grong khyer zhugs tshapa'i tshe / /mkha' las sgra ni 'di skad grags par gyur/ /'dod chags zad mtha' stong dben gang rtogs pa/ /yang dag nyid rtogs byang chub thob 1 par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das ni grong khyer zhugs 18pa'i tshe/ /mkha' las sgra ni 'di skad grags par gyur/ /'dod chags skye mtha' stong dben gang rtogs pa/ /yang dag nyid rtogs byang chub thob sna par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das ni grong khyer zhugs — )pa'i tshe/ /mkha' las sgra ni 'di skad grags par gyur/ /'dod chags mtha' ni stong dben gang rtogs pa/ /yang dag nyid rtogs byang chub thob 2148wa 631

par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das ni grong khyer zhugs7)pa'i tshe/ /mkha' las sgra ni 'di skad grags par gyur/ /'dod chags rab zhidzabastong dben gang rtogs pal/ /yang dag nyid rtogs byang chub thobalgepar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das ni grong khyer zhugasalgepa'i tshe/ /mkha' las sgra ni 'di skad grags par gyur/ /'dod chags 'jug pa grubastong dben gang rtogs pa/ / yang dag7nyid rtogs byang chub thob lapar 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das ni grong khyer zhugasalgepa'i tshe/ /mkha' las sgra ni 'di skad grags par gyur/ /'dod chags med cing stong dben gang rtogs pa/ /⑨yang dag nyid rtogs byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das ni grong khyer zhugs 7pa'i tshe/ /mkha' las sgra ni 'di skad grags par gyur/ /'dod chags skye med nyunyastong dben gang rtogs〈nyepa/ /yang dag nyid rtogs 32byang chub 8thob par 'gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das ni grong khyer zhugs gepa'i tshe/ /mkha' las sgra ni 'di skad grags par gyur/ /'dod chags rab 'gog stong dben gang rtogs pa/ /yang dag nyid rtogs byang chub thob par 'gyur/ /zhe snang gti mug khong khro 'chab ser sna/ /g.yo sgyu khengs dang nga rgyal mya ngan dang / /sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'gog pa lam sems can/ /khye'urwa snadang bu mo bud med dag dang ni/ /skyes pa nyusnyegaso ba dag dang dbang po drug /yul drug 'byung chen bzhi yi dngos po dang / /'jig rten sdug bsngal phung porwartekhams dag ri )dang / /'jig rten skye sgra rduteming sogs kyang sa de bzhinazhun/ /chos rje zhu༄dam pa'i chos ni bstan pas na/ /sems can thams cad rab tu dga' bar gyur/ /lha yi 'jig rten kun kyang thos gyur nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i theg la dgeganas par mos/ /bcom ldan 'das ni grong khyer zhugasadza 40—632

pa'i tshe/ /mkha' las sgra ni 'di skad grags par gyur/ /bcom ldan sbyin stobs dag la rab mos pas/ /sbyin pa'i stobs kyis byang chub brnyesas11par gyur / /bcom ldan 'das ni grong khyer zhugasam pa'i tshe/ /mkha' las sgra ni 'di skad grags par gyur/ /bcom ldan tshul khrims rnams dag rab mos pas/ /tshul khrims rnam dag7stobs kyis byang chub brnyes5/ /bcom ldan 'das ni grong khyer zhugasalgepa'i tshe/ /mkha' las sgra ni 'di skad grags par gyur/ /bcom ldan bzod pa dag la rab mos pas/ /bzod pa'i stobs kyis byang chub brnyesalgepar gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das ni grong khyer zhugs 87pa'i tshe/ /mkha' lasakyisgra ni 'di skad grags par gyur/ /bcom ldan brtson 'grus dag la rab mos pas/ /brtson 'grus stobs kyis byang chub brnyes par gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das ni grong khyer zhugs pa'i tshe/ /mkha' las 11sgra ni 'di skad grags par gyur/ /bcom ldan bsam gtan dag la rab mos pas/ /bsam gtan stobs kyis byang chub brnyes par gyur/ /bcom ldan 'das ni grong khyer zhugs72pa'i tshe/ /mkha' las〈nyesgra ni 'di skad grags par gyur/ /bcom ldan mishes rab dag la rab mos pas/ /shes rab stobs kyis byang chub brnyes par gyur/ /rdzu 'phrul mngon shes yon tan gnas shes stobs/ /thabs dang gzungs 7kyi stobs dang grags pa'i stobs/ /las dang rten 'byung 1 yan lag dad dang thos//stong dang 'thun hu3pa'i stobs dang rab zhi 16stobs/ /rab dul yang dag mtha' dang dbenamanye mkhas stobs me/ /'jigs dang dga' dang phan 'dogs la mos dang ske/ /byams dang ()snying rje dga' snyoms bzod 'tshe 22med/ /stong dang mtshan ma med sogs kyang (༄de bzhinari lha/ /stobs bcu 'phags pa'i mnga' du 548—633
