bdag lha yi gtso/ /yon tan grags pa dpe zla ma mchis pa/ /grong khyer mchog gshegs zhabs ni bzhag pa'i tshe/ /sems can rnams la rgya cher phan pa mdzad/ /sngon chad srid gsum las dge rab bsgrubs pas1/ /lha yi dge ba sna tshogs 'phel 2bar mdzad/ /'jig rten thams cad kyisang ni rab tu bkur/ /nga yi bstan pa 'di thos thams cad dga'/ /bcom ldan grong khyer gshegs nas zhabs bzhag tshe / /grong khyer sa chen dag ni rab tu g.yos/ /bcom ldan rnam dag 'od zer mthong bas na/ /ngo mtshar mi 'dzin mi dga' gang yang med/ /bcom ldan grong gshegs phan pa cher mdzad pas/ /lha mi'i pa'akhor rnams sems ni dga' bar gyur6/ /sa dang mkha' 'gro dag gis srid gsum na/ /bcom ldan shin tu bde zhes bsngags par gyur/ /bcom ldan zhabs kyi 'khor lo sa bzhag tshe / /rnam dag 'od zer kun gsal ngo mtshar gyur/ /rta ni cang shes grong khyer sgra snyan phyung / /bya tshogs dag kyang mkha' las rab tu dga'/ /gzhan yang rab dang bud med mang po yi/ /lag dang rkang dang 8gdub 'khor phreng ba dang / /de bzhin rin chen 1 rgyan ni sna tshogs las/ /ma dkrol ba 11yang rang las 12sgra snyan byung / /so sor phan tshun dga' ba'i gtam brjod cing //skad 'thun bkra 15shis mchog gis bsngags 1 pa brjod/ /'on long dbang po ma tshang dbang po thob/ /thams cad bcom ldan khyad 'phags 'bras bu dbang 15/ /bcom ldan grong khyer gshegs tshe kun dga' bas/ /lha mis lame tog mngon par 1 mchod pa byas/ /mkha' las kun du 1 sgra snyan 19byung bas na/ /lha tshogs tshad med rab tu dga' bar gyur/ /gzhan yang sems can dran pa nyams pa dag /smyos 'khrugs rab zhi phan tshun gtam snyan brjod / /bud 40wa 634

med gang sbrum mya ngan 'jigs gyur pa/ /'od zer byin 1gyis bde ba thob par gyur / /skyes pa bud med ngo tsha khrel bcas las/ /dri ma spangs pa'i chos dag rab bshad pas/ /thams cad dga' nas dag dpa'i sems bskyed de/ /thub 4mchog zhabs la spyi btud phyag 5byas nas/ /kha cig 6bcom ldan bla med lam rab tshol / /kha cig byang chub sems dpa' nyan thos tsholan/ /bcom ldan grong khyer mchog tu gshegs pas na/ /bcom ldan zhal du lta 9zhing rang nyid dga' / /bcom ldan mkhyen pas sa yi spyod rtogs pas/ /'jig rten rjes 'thun nya )phan pa rab tu mdzad/ /chos kyi nor mchog byang chub sems dpa' byin / /rin chen 11mchog ni sems can rnams la btang / /bcom ldan grong khyer gshegs pa'i tshe/ /mkha' las 12sgra ni 'di skad byung 1ri/ /gang zhig mig zad mtha' sred pa/ /sangs rgyas la ni gus pa yin/ /bcom ldan grong khyer gshegs pa'i tshe/ /mkha' las ngasgra ni 'di skad byung 15/ /gang zhig mig skye mtha' sred 7pa/ /sangs rgyas la ni gus pa yin/ /gang zhig mig zad mtha' sred pa/ /sangs rgyas yid ches mi 'jigs 'thob1 / /mig zad mthar 1 ni lta bas na/ /shin tu dang ba 19rgyun mi 'chad/ /gang zhig mig zad mtha' sred pa / /chos la yid ches mi 'jigs 'thob 1/ /mig zad mthar ni lta bas na/ /shin tu dang ba 22rgyun mi 'chad/ /gang zhig mig zad mtha' sred pa/ /dge 'dun yid ches dmi 'jigs 'thob / /mig zad mthar 25ni lta bas can/ /shin tu dang ba rgyun mi 'chad/ /gang zhig mig zad mtha' sred 8pa/ /tshul khrims 'dzin med thob par 'gyur/ /mig zad mthar 29ni lta bas na/ /shin tu dang bke1rgyun mi 'chad/ /gang zhig mig zad mtha' sred pa/ /ngan 'gro'i 48—635

'dod chags spong bar 'gyur/ /mig zad mthar ni lta bsamanyanan/ /'dod chags rgyun ni 55spong bar byed/ /gang zhig mig zad mtha'abyud sred pa/ /ngan 'gro'i zhe sdang spong bar 'gyur/ /mig zad mthar ni lta bas na ri/ /zhe snang rgyun ni spong bar byed/ /gang zhig mig zad mtha' zisred pa/ /ngan 'gro'i gti mug 6spong bar 'gyur/ /mig zad mthar 7ni lta bas rin/ /gti mug rgyun ni spong bar byed/ /gang zhig mig zad mtha' 9 sred pa'i/ /byang chub ye shes dag la gnas/ /mig zad mthar ni lta bas 11na/ /byang chub ye shes rgyun mi 'chad/ /mig 12skye mtha' dang 1 mig gi mtha'/ /'jug pa dang ni rab dben dang / /yod pa nyid du mi 'gyur dang / /mi skye rab tu zhi ba dang / /'di la chosogs pa'i sgo rnams kyang / /thams cad mig zad 'dra bar bstan/ /gang zhig mig zad mthar 15srid pa/ /de ni rtag tu the tshom med/ /de ltar the tshom med pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul thob par 'gyur/ /gang zhig mig skye lamatha' sred pa/ /de ni rtag tu the tshom med/ /de ltar the tshom med pa'i phyir / /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul 'thob 1 par 'gyur/ /gang zhig mig gi mtha' sred 1 pa/ /de ni rtag tu the tshom med/ /de ltar the tshom med pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul 'thob 19par 'gyur/ /gang zhig mig gi 'jug sred pa/ /de ni rtag tu the tshom med/ /de ltar the tshom med pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul 'thob 2 par 'gyur/ /gang zhig mig dben rab 21sred pa/ /de ni rtag tu the tshom med/ /de ltar the tshom med pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul 'thob 22par 'gyur/ /gang zhig mig na mi skye 2 sred pa/ /de ni rtag tu the tshom med/ /de ltar the tshom med pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul 'thob dpar 'gyur/ /40wa 636

gang zhig mig med la sred pa/ /de ni rtag tu the tshom med/ /de ltar the tshom med pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul 'thob 1par 'gyur/ /gang zhig mig zhi la na sred pa/ /de ni rtag tu the tshom med/ /de ltar the tshom med pa'i phyir/ /3sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul 'thob 4par 'gyur/ /rna ba sna lce lus dang yid/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya nas/ /sgra dang ming gi bar du yang / /thams cad de bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /mig skye dpag med gang skyed 5pa/ /ye shes dpag med skyed 6par byed/ /ye shes dpag tu med pa'i phyir/ /chos 'di bstan pa'ang 7de bzhin no/ /mig zad dpag 8med gang shes pa/ /mig la sgrib pa med par 'gyur / /de ltar sgrib pa med pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas mkhyen pa thogs med 'thob ske/ /rna ba sna lce 1 lus dang yid/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya nas/ /sgra dang ming gi bar du 11yang / /thams cad de bzhin sbyar bar bya1 / /bcom ldan grong khyer gshegs pa'i tshe/ /sems can dag ni brgya stong snyed1lha/ /mkha' las chos bshad sgra thos pas / /sangs rgyas yon tan the tshom med/ /kha cig 'dod chags sems byung yang / /sangs rgyas ye shes 'jigs mi byed/ /gang zhig 'dod chags sems byung yang / /sangs rgyas yon tan 15stor ma ma gyur/ /kha cig 'dod chags sems byung yang / /bla med ye shes chol 1 byed cing / /ma 'dres chos ni bsgrub 1 pa dang / /nyan thos theg pa mos mi byed/ /byis pa bsam gtan sgom 19byed kyang / /bsam gtan bde la mos pas na/ /mngon pa'i nga rgyal rab bskyed nas/ /dge sbyong ge 'bras bu thob snyam sems/ /byis pa bsam 2 gtan sgom na byed kyang / /mi 2 zad mtha' yi shes med 25na/ / bskal pa 2 :brgya stong sgom 2 byed kyang / / de la 2 rnam grol ci yang med/ /skye 40wa 637

ba len pa thams cad ni/ /de la zhen chags skyed 1par byed/ /gal te skye nyid nastong rig na/ /mthong ba rnams ni rnam dag 'gyur/ /gang zhig bsam gtan bzhi bsgrubs kyang / /mig zad mtha' shes med gyur na/ /bskal pa brgya stong lon yang cani/ /bsam gtan yongs su dag mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig nyer bsdogs 5thob gyur kyang / /zad mtha' shes pa 'thob 6mi 'gyur/ /zad pa thob pa ma shes phyir/ /zag pa thob la 7rtag tu spyod/ /gang zhig 'du shes zhen byed pa/ /'du shes zad mtha'i shes pa med/ /'du shes zad pa ma shes phyir/ /rtag tu 'du shes zag la spyod/ /gang zhig 'jig rten zhen chags pa/ /'jig rten zad mtha' shes pa medan/ /'jig rten zad mtha' ma shes phyir/ /rtag tu 'jig rten zag la spyod/ /gang zhig zag bcas sems la gnas/ /sems zad mtha' yi shes pa med/ /sems zad pa ni ma shes phyir/ /rtag tu sems ni zag la spyod/ /gang zhig zag bcas chos la gnas/ /chos zad mtha' yi shes pa med / /chos zad pa ni ma shes phyir/ /rtag tu zag bcas chos la spyod/ /sbyangs pa'i chos la gnas gyur kyang / /mig 1 zad mtha' yi shes med na/ /mig zad pa ni ma shes phyir/ /yang dag sbyangs la gnas pa min 2/ /kha dog sgyur ba'i gos bgos kyang / /mig zad 15mtha' yi dzishes med na/ /mig zad pa ni ma shes phyir / /yang dag chos gos bgos ma yin/ /ya rabs rigs su skyes gyur kyang / /mig zad mtha' yi shes med na/ / mig zad pa 17ni ma shes phyir/ /de ni dag pa'i 2 rigs ma yin/ /'khor mang 21dag ni bdog gyur kyang / /mig 22zad mtha' yi shes med na/ /myur du ngan 'gror lhung 'gyur ter / /'khor dag gis 2 ni skyob mi nus25/ /sgra yi rig 27pa mkhas 40wa 638

gyur kyang / /mig zad mtha' yi shes med na/ /mig 1zad pa ni ma shes phyir/ /sgra yi rig pa rtogs ma 5yin/ /bzo rnams la ni mkhas gyur kyang / /mig zad mtha' yi shes med na/ /mig zad pa ni ma shes phyir/ /de ni bzo la mkhas ma yin/ /'dri 4ba mang la mkhas gyur cing 5/ /yi ge gcig gis 6rnam 'byed kyang / /mig zad mtha' yi shes med na/ /de ni don 'thun 7bshad ma yin / /mkhas pa'i rjes su slob nabyed kyang / /gsang dang gsang min mi shes shing ske/ /mig zad mtha' yi shes med na/ /chos 'di 9rtogs par mi 'gyur ro/ /brjod 1 pa sna tshogs rgyang pan 1 dang / /chos rnams rab tu shes gyur kyang / /mig zad mtha' yi 12shes med na/ /'khri nashing stug por lhung ba 'dra/ /sgra yi rig pa mkhas gyur cing k+ṣa/ /dge dang mi dge'i 15rtags ston dang sa / /tshig 'bru yi ge sgra skad 1 dang / /klog dang 'don pa'i mthar thug kyang 18/ /mig zad mtha' ni ma shes na/ /19de dag rnams ni shes med yin/ /bud med dag gi 2 mtshan ma dang / /tshig mkhan rmongs par byed pa dang / /lus mnyes 21ngal sos chos rnams dang / /mkhyud dpyad dag la mkhas gyur kyang / /mig zad mtha' ni ma shes na/ /de dag rnams ni shes med yin / /gzhung lugs brgya mang ston byed cing / /yi ge 'bru gcig 2 mi brjed kyang / /mig zad mtha' ni ma shes na/ /bshad pa de ni don med yin/ /de bzhin mig skye mtha' dag dang ske/ / mig mtha' 2 dang ni 'jug pa nas/ /rab tu zhi ba'i bar du yang / /de bzhin du ni rig par gyis/ /rna ba sna lce lus dang yid/ /gzugs sgra dri ro 25reg bya nas/ /sgra dang ming gi bar du yang / /thams cad de bzhin sbyar bar bya / /sgra yi rig pa klog 'don cing / /de yi don ni rtogs gyur kyang / /mig lo1wa 639

zad mtha' ni ma shes natsho/ /de ni nam yang nadaman pa yin/ /smrang gzhi'agyidag ni 'don byed cing / /gsang sngags dag ni rtogs gyur kyang / /mig zad mtha' ni ma shes na/ /de ni nam yang skuradaman pa yin/ /de bzhin migamachi5)skye mtha' dag dang 7/ /mig gi mtha' dang 'jug pa nas87/ /rab tu zhi ba'i bar du yang / /de bzhin du ni 97rig par gyis/ /rna ba sna lce lus dang yid/ /gzugs sgra dri ro 1 reg bya nas/ /sgra dang ming gi bar du yang / /thams cad de bzhin sbyar bar bya11// //32 bam po bzhi pa/ bcom ldan grong khyer gshegs pa'i tshe/ /sems can dag ni tshad med snyed/ /mkha' las chos bstan sgra thos pas/ /mig zad mtha' yi shes pa thob/ /bcom ldan grong khyer gshegs pa'i tshe/ /sems can dag ni tshad med snyed/ /mkha' las chos bstan sgra thos pas/ /mig gi rang bzhin rtogs par gyur/ /stong dang bdag med rab rtogs pas/ /thams cad rnam dag mig thob 'gyur/ /rna ba sna lce lus dang yid/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya nas / /sgra dang ming gi bar du yang / /thams cad de bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /'dod sdang gti mug khong khro dang / /nga rgyal khengs dang g.yo sgyu nas/ /bag med pa yi bar du yang / /de bzhin du ni rig par gyis/ /bcom ldan grong khyer gshegs pa'i tshe/ /sems can dag ni tshad med snyed/ /steng gi nam mkha' dag las ni/ /sangs rgyas mtshan ni sna tshogs thos/ /kha cig 'dod chags 'jigs pa yi/ /dpe 1 zla med pa ca1 ming yang thos/ /kha cig zhe sdang 'jigs byed cing / /'jig rten 15phan 'dogs ming dag 9thos/ /kha cig gti mug rab rtogs shing / /nga rgyal 'dul ba'i ming dag 1 thos/ /kha cig 40wa 640

'jig rten dag la ni/ /rab zhi ston pa'i 'dren 17ming thosa'on / /kha cig shes rab dag bstan nas/ /'jig rten phan 'dogs ming dag 5)thos/ /kha cig thabs dag rab bstan nas/ /sems can phan 'dogs ming dag thos/ /kha cig bdud ni rab btul kyang / /'khon ca'adzin med pa'i ming dag thos/ /kha cig gsung geskarab chos dag gis/ /rnam grol bstan pa'i ming dag thos/ /kha cig sems can sdug bsngal ba/ /rgya cher sgrol ba'i kyiming dag thos/ /kha cig mi yi gtso bo yis/ /'jig rten sgrol ba'i ming dag thos/ /ming ni de dag thos gyur nas/ /thams cad rnam dag mig 7thob gyur/ /nam mkha' dang nani rgya mtsho'i chu/ /ri rab lhun po'i bar du yang / /thams cad gzhal smyo du rung srid 1 kyil/ /sangs rgyas mkhyen pa thub 11mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig mig zad 12nges pa thob gyur na/ /chos sku mngon par 'grub 1 pa dka' mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig chos sku mchog ni grub migyur na/ /kun 'dzin ye shes dpag med thob par 'gyur/ /gang zhig kun 'dzin ye shes dpag med thob/ /des ni mdo sde dpag med go bar 'gyuram/ /gang zhig mdo sde dpag med go gyur pasapa/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul 'thob pa hu dka' mi 'gyur/ /gang zhig mig skye nges pa thob nya gyur na/ /chos sku mngon par 'grub tsho//pa dka' 3 tshomi 'gyur/ /gang zhig chos sku 7 nyamachog ni grub gyur na/ /kun 'dzin ye shes dpag med 'thob 22par 'gyur/ /gang zhig kun 'dzin ye shes dpag med thob/ /des ni mdo sde dpag med go bar 'gyur / /gang zhig mdo sde dpag med go gyur pas lha/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul thob pa (snyedaka' mi 'gyur/ /de bzhin rna ba sna lce lus dang yid/ /gzugs sgra dri ro 2gereg bya 24chos dag nas/ /sgra rnams dang ni ming gi bar du yang / /48wa 641

thams cad de bzhin du ni sbyar bar tshobya/ /de tshe sa chen dag ni rab tu g.yos/ /rgya mtsho ri 5rnams kyang ni 5de bzhin no/ /lha ma yin dang lha ni mang po rnams/ /thams cad rab tu dga' ba skyes par gyur/ /bdud dang bdud dpung g.yo sgyu rab bcom nas/ /thams cad sangs rgyas bkod pa bsgrub ripar mos lha rnams so sor rigazhal med khang zhugs nas/ /phan tshun dga' ba'i gtam ni 'di skad smras/ /'dren pa deng ni 'jig rten byung bas na/ /lha mi thams cad la ni phan pa mdzad/ /sa bla'i lha 'khor gzhal med khang gnas nas/ / dang ba'i 6sems kyis dga' nas 'di skad du/ /'dren pa 'jig rten deng byung shin tu legs/ /'jig rten kun bde 7rgyu ni rab tu mdzad/ /mkha' la naspyod pa'i 9lha rnams de thos nas/ /thams cad dga' nas rab tu dang ba skyes/ /khyad 'phags sgra snyan sangs rgyas bsngags brjod nas/ /'dren pa byung bas 'jig rten phan mdzad zer/ /rgyal chen rigasatshwa bzhi'i lha rnams 11de thos nas/ /thams cad dga' nas shin tu dang ba 1 skyes/ /khyad 'phags sgra snyan sangs rgyas bsngags brjod nas/ /'dren pa byung bas 'jig rten phan mdzad zer/ /sum cu rtsa gsum lhas 1 ni de thos nas/ /thams cad dga' nas shin du dang ba ḍiskyes / /khyad 'phags sgra snyan sangs rgyas bsngags brjod nas/ /'dren pa byung bas 'jig rten phan mdzad zer/ /'thab bral skulha dag de skad thos nas ni/ /thams cad dga' nas shin du dang ba 7skyes/ /khyad 'phags sgra snyan sangs rgyas bsngags brjod nas/ /'dren pa byung nas nyi 'jig rten phan mdzad zer/ /bdag cag byang chub sems ni 18rab bskyed nas/rte/ /bcom ldan bla med mkhyen pa 2 nye bar bgyi/ /lha mi'i 21gtso mchog la ni brten nas su/ /sems can 40wa 642

thams cad sgrol bar bgyid ces zer/ /dga' ldan lha rnams de skad thos nas kyang ske/ /thams cad dga' nas shin du dang ba ༅skyes/ /khyad 'phags sgra snyan 5sangs rgyas bsngags brjod nas/ /'dren pa byung bas 'jig rten phan mdzad zer / /bcom ldan 'das kyis sebaskal pa bye bar ni/ /spyod mchog khyad 'phags dpag gemed mngon ltabasgrubs nas6/ /sems can sdug 77bsngal ba la bde lam bstan/ /'khor ba bsgral nanas mya ngan 'das la 9bkod/ /'phrul dga'i lha rnams de skad thos nas 1 ni/ /thams cad dga' nas shin du dang ba 11skyes / /khyad 'phags sgra snyan sangs rgyas bsngags brjod nas/ /'dren pa byung bas 'jig rten phan mdzad zer/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed lhas ni 12de thos nas / /thams cad dga' nas shin du dang ba 1 skyes/ /khyad 'phags sgra snyan sangs rgyas bsngags brjod nas/ /'dren pa byung nas 7'jig rten phan mdzad zer / /de bzhin gshegs pa skye shi 'das pas 15na/ /bdud dang mu stegs mang po phamatsha par mdzad/ /bla med byang chub dag ni yongs rdzogs nas/ /skye dgu drangs hu nas pha rol 'jog ces 12zer/ /tshangs ris lha rnams de skad thos nas kyang 16/ /thams cad dga' nas shin du dang ba 2 skyes/ /khyad 'phags sgra snyan sangs rgyas bsngags brjod nas/ /'dren pa byung bas 'jig rten phan mdzad zer / /de bzhin gcig nas gcig tu sgra thos pas/ /tshangs pa'i 'khor rnams dga' nas 'di skad du/ /'dren pa byung bas 'jig rten phan pa mdzad/ /bdud dpung 'jigs ni1skrag mya ngan byed ces zer/ /srid 32pa'i rtse mo'i lha yi 3lhabar du yang / /sangs rgyas byung nas 24'jig rten phan mdzad thos/ /de bzhin sgra ni kun du grags pas na/ /lha ma yin dag 'gribs shing gi lha rnams 'phel/ /40wa 643

bdud kyi khang pa dag ni yongs stongs shing / /lha rnams 'khor ni rab tu rgyas par gyur/ /mi 'jigs 1stobs kyis tsho log pa sku norab btul nas/ /byang chub chen po la mchog ni myur du brnyes/ /de bzhin skad cig 55yud tsam lha rnams kyisal/ /bcom ldan byung nas phan mdzad thos gyur nas ni/ /'jig rten 'dren par mdzad pa shin du legs/ /rnam dag mig ri ni sems can sbyin zhes zer/ /bcom ldan grong khyer gshegs pa'i tshe/ /'dod pas yongs su gdungs dukhupa rnams / /mi gtsang bsgom 9)pa bshad thos pas1 no/ /'dod chags zhi ste ma lus spangs / /bcom ldan grong khyer gshegs pa'i tshe/ /zhe sdang dag gis gdungs pa rnams / /byams pa bstan pa'i chos thos pas/ /zhe sdang zhi ste ma lus spangs/ /bcom ldan grong khyer gshegs pa'i tshe/ /gti mug dag gis 11gdungs pa rnams//shes rab chos ni bstan thos pas/ /gti mug zhi ste ma lus spangs/ /bcom ldan grong khyer gshegs pa'i tshe/ /nga rgyal dag gis gdungs 32pa rnams/ /nga rgyal spangs pa'i chos thos pas/ /nga rgyal zhi ste ma lus spangs/ /bcom ldan grong khyer gshegs pa'i tshe/ /phrag dog dag gis gdungs pa rnams/ /phrag dog spangs pa'i chos thos pas/ /phrag dog zhi ste ma lus spangs/ /bcom ldan grong khyer gshegs pa'i tshe/ /khong khro dag gis gdungs pa rnams/ /khong khro spangs pa'i chos thos pas/ /khong khro zhi ste ma lus spangs/ /bcom ldan grong khyer gshegs pa'i tshe/ /ser sna dag gis gdungs pa rnams/ /ser sna spangs pa'i chos thos pas/ /ser sna zhi ste ma lus spangs/ /gang zhig dul nya ba'i spyod grubamasapal/ /dpag med chos ni 'di thos pas/ /mang du thos 8pa'i mtshor zhugs nasas / /kun 'dzin sgo ni sgrub par byed/ /gzhan yang mkha' las sgra thos 40wa 644

pas / /me tog dag gis 37sangs rgyas mchod/ /yon tan khyad par 'phags sgrubabacing / /snying rje chen po'i rdzu 'phrul ston/ /gzhan yang mkha' las sgra thos pas/ /bcom ldan sku dang /skye gnas dang / /gdung rgyud nanodang ni gsung sgra rnams/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i bsngags pa brjod/ /sems can 'gro ba ji lta b.rage/ /rdzu 'phrul dag kyang ci rigs bshad/ /mig dang rna ba sna lce lus/ /gzugs dang sgra la sogs pasngonadang / /bskum pa dang ni brkyang 7rib dgan /ston par mdzad pa khyad par 'phags/ /bcom ldan 'jig rten 'das pas 9rin//'jig rten sgron ma rab mdzad cing / /gzugs ni mang po 1 ston pa yang /thams cad sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul yin/ /snod dang snod min de rjes su/ /mi 'thun 37chos ni ston〈rtemadzad pas/ /sems can tshe rabs tshad med nas/ /sangs rgyas mchod pa nyu ma byas shing / /dmu 3 rirgod gdul 15bar dka' ba las/ /sems can dmyal bar bshad par 3 tshomadzad/ /gang zhig las lam 12rmongs gyur cing nyarte/ /lta ( — )la brten nas spros dga' ba/ /bcom ldan de dag lta 21ba dang / /spros5)pa zhi ba'i sgra thos mdzad/ /gzhan yang mkha' las ngo bo nyid/ /nges pa nyid du stong pa dang / /'gro 'ong med cing mtshan med dang / /ci yang med pa'i sgra yang thos/ /gzhan yang sems can brgya stong dag /mkha' risalas sha dang shes rab spyan/ /de bzhin chos kyi spyan bar dun / /yang dag ston pa'i sgra yang thos/ /bcom ldan rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis ni/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab sgra/ /rnam grol rnam grol mthong ba'i sgra/ /ston pa dag kyang thos par gyur / /sems can dag ni tsho geji snyed la/ /ji dzo kyibazhin rdzu 'phrul rab bstan nas( tsho / /ji ltar rjes 'thun /sgra skad kyis/ /yang dag chos ni bstan par 40wa 645

mdzad / /sems can la la gang zhig ni37/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod bsgrub rinamos / /rdzu 'phrul mos pa ji lta bzhin/ /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod sgra ston/ /bcom ldan rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis ni/ /sems can dbang po ji lta bzhin/ /rgya cher yang dag 'byed mdzad pas/ /len ngu'adzin ston la dgod 3par mdzad/ /bcom ldan rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis ni/ /phung po khams dang skye mched kyitho/ /bcings dang grol dang nye 57)ring dang / /sa yi gnas skabs bye brag gi/ /mtshan nyid ston 48)pa thos par gyur/ /gzhan yang sa dang ye shes kyi/ /'od zer tshad med ston pa dang / /nyon mongs bag chags spangs pa 49)dang / /spangs min 1 moston pa thos par gyur/ /bcom ldan rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis ni/ /lha dang mi yi ngo bo nyid/ /las dang 'bras bu mi mtshungs pas/ /skye len tha dad thos par gyur/ /res 'ga' bud med mdun dag tu/ /bud med brgyan pa'i lus sprul nas/ /mkha' las skyo ston sgra bsgrags pas/ /gang thos 'dod chags sel bar mdzad/ /shā 17ri'i bu ni ji lta 32bzhin/ /shin du dang ba skyes gyur pa1lha/ /thugs rjes mos pa ji bzhin du/ /bla med chos ni ston par mdzad/ / mod gal bu dang tsha'od srung skadang / / ka pi na dang tshekun dga' dang / /'od srung 1 chen po dag dang ni/ /kun shes kau di n+ya 18la sogs/ /de dag mos pa 1/ji bzhin du/ /nyan thos chos ston thos par gyur/ /lha rnams dang ni lha ma yin/ /gnod sbyin dag ni mang po dang / /be 3 tshor ka ni 'khor bcas dang 21/ /grul sa bum dag ni tshad med rnams/ /bcom ldan rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis ni/ /gzungs sngags 2nyesgra ni thos par gyur/ /i di si/ bi di zhu si/lha/i ra su/ i ri phyor/ au tshon si/ ma na sa si/ u khyi/ a no 2/khyi/ a khris 40wa 646

tsa la mang rnam༅ye/ daras ni shra ri ni mi/ ta ka ni/ e 44 mi man tra/ ni ha ra / a bu re/ bud dhegs/ ni re(6/ a khi tsham ra/ bi ya ki riman ya te/a khi tshamanyu)ra ba ra mi 9tenyunya/ ka lā 12ba hi 15ni/ sarbo thu bing shi sna ni ra dhe bo tson / patshwanyer sha sad tehunye/ sha sa 19ta/ pa 3 )ra sha sad ta/ ta ra sad ta/bhū mi/ ā ma bha ra/ li la bha 21na/ shi tsa 3 tsid ta snye/ bi ba ma ti ste/ tsid ta a nan ta/ o du 2be ra du 9ha ba mi 2 ta bhū mi na/ na nam kā 39ni/ a ka ning bi gi57mid te(rte/ sha ri bi sbyo/ a lham la ni ma lā/ pung li te0lhan ra shis tsa/ha ha ri/ ma ma lī / bhamatshar nis ti s+tha/ tsak+ṣu ni ra hamu1 ra/ u dha ri ta pa tsi/ an ta 4)ri/ ku ta ri byu/ ke tu gsu ke tu su pa ra ni/ ka ra ni / ku ༄9su ma ni spus / ka ka 51ri/ ka kha 52ri/ u 52pa la mū ni ri/ ti sbrang ra nisnyen/ nā༄9ga ni ra ha reg / pa ra ladas te/ amu te pa ra ya te/an41ta ra ༄shrībhan dhe/ an geta ra ta bha ti shi tsa/ ha si ri lha/ ma kha li/khri ni sam bhasdo more62/ ti sbyo sit+tas(ra ni / ku bhu lo tsa te/ gzhan yang rgyal po rnam thos bu/ /yul 'khor srungate1ni la sogs pas tshon/ /khyad 'phags sgra ni grangs med kyis/ /bden pa'i sngagasate tshig rab tu smras/ /tshad med sgra ni de dag kyang / /bde gshegs rdzu 'phrul dbang gis byungage/ /rdzu 'phrul dag ni tshad med pas / /bstan pa dag kyangaletshad med pas / /res 'ga' sangs rgyas med zhing du/ /rdzu 'phrul rol ba'i stobs dag gis/ /'khor bskor sangs rgyas sku ston pa 5nya/ /da ltar mthong ba jite(bzhin no/ /bsam gyis mi khyab zhing dag tu/ /sprul pa tshad med ston mdzad pasani tsho/ /bltams 2stonas gom pa bdun gshegs dang / /rgyal srid spangs nas 82rab byung dang nalha/ /byang chub snying por 48wa 647

sangs rgyas nas/ /brnyes 1pa'i chos dag rab dgongs te/ /chos kyi 'khor lo skor 2mdzad dang / /mya ngan 'das pa ston par mdzad/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi 0ni stobs dag gis/ /sna tshogs chos ni ston mdzad pas/ /sems can dag ni tshad med rnams/ /khyad 'phags ye shes grub par mdzad/ /de tshe thugs rje chen po yis/ /tshangs pa'i 'khor gyis yongs 4)bskorang nonas/ /byams chos bsgom 6)pa bshad 7ribastan pasan / /byams pa'i sems ni 'phel bar mdzad/ /de tshe thugs rje chen po yis1)/ /lha rnams kyis ni yongs bskor nas/ /bsdu ba'i dngos bzhi bstan mdzad 1 )pas/ /bsdu 11ba'i spyod tsho/rtebazhi 'phel bar mdzad / /de tshe thugs rje chen po yis/ /klu 3gernams kyis ni yongs bskor nas/ /zhe sdang nyes dmigs bshad bstan pas/ /zhe sdang sems ni spangs par gyur/ /de tshe thugs rje chen po yis/ /gnod sbyin rnams kyis yongs bskor nas/ /rnam 'tshe 14nyes dmigs bshad bstan pasam/ /rnam 'tshe 8sems ni spangs par gyur / /de tshe thugs rje chen po yis/ /lha ma yin gyis yongs bskor nas/ /'thab pa'i nyes dmigs bshad bstan te/ /bzod pa bsgoms 3 dīpa'i bsngags pa brjod/ /de tshe thugs rje chen po yis/ /nam mkha' lding gis yongs bskor 3shenas / /'gal byas nyes dmigs bshad bstan te/ /'dum pa'i sems kyis nyushebasngags pa mdzad / /de tshe thugs rje chen po yis/ /dri za'i 'khor gyis yongs bskor nas/ /dga' ba'i tshig ni dpag med kyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsngags brjod bstan/ /de tshe thugs rje chen po yis/ /sto 'phye 27'khor gyis yongs 22bskor nas/ /mu stegs chos la smod ri lhemadzad cing ni ri/ /bcom ldan gsung rab 25bsngags brjod bstan/ /de tshe thugs rje chen po yis/ /'dre srin 40wa 648

'khor gyis yongs bskor nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan mchog /rgya cher bsngags pa bstan par mdzad/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrulas1)bstan pas/ /sems can dag ni brgya stong snyedarig/ /mig zad gumatha' cibastan thos pas na5/ /mthar phyin don ni rtogs par gyur/ /thugs rje chen pos 6)'phrul bstan pas/ /sems can dag ni brgya stong snyed/ /migs47)skye mtha' ni bstan thos pas /mthar phyin don ni rtogs par gyur/ /thugs rje chen pos na'aphrul bstan pas/ /sems can dag ni brgya stong snyedakye / /mig gi nya snamatha' ni bstan thos pas/ /mthar phyin don 17ni rtogs par gyur/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan pasahuste/ /sems can dag ni brgya stong snyed/ /mig 'jug bstan pa thos gyur nasatunye / /mthar phyin don ni rtogs 1 par gyur/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan pas/ /sems can dag ni brgya stong snyed/ /mig dben bstan 15pa thos pas na/ /mthar phyin don ni rtogs par gyur/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan pas/ /sems can dag ni brgya stong snyed/ /mig la skye med tshabastan 3 tshothos pasahunye/ /mthar phyin don ni rtogs par gyur/ /thugs rje 17chen pos 'phrul bstan pas/ /sems can dag ni brgya stong snyed/ /mig med 2 bstan pa 1thos pas na(rnye/ /mthar phyin don ni rtogs par gyur/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan pas/ /sems can dag ni brgya stong snyed/ /mig ni nyer zhi 2nyibastan 2 rithos pas( snye/ /mthar phyin don ni rtogs par gyur/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan pas/ /sems can dag ni brgya stong snyed/ /mig la bdag med ri zhibastan shu )thos pas/ /da mthar phyin don ni rtogs par gyur/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan pas/ /sems can dag ni brgya stong snyed/ /mig la 40wa 649

gang zag med thos pas/ /mthar phyin don ni rtogs par gyur/ /thugs rje chen pos 17'phrul bstan pas/ /sems can dag ni brgya stong snyed/ /mig la sems can med thos pas/ /mthar phyin don ni rtogs par gyur/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan pas/ /sems can dag ni brgya stong snyed/ /mig la srog med thos pas na / /mthar phyin don ni rtogs par gyur/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan pas/ /sems can dag ni brgya stong snyed/ /mig la gso ba med thos pas/ /mthar phyin don ni rtogs par gyur/ /thugs rje chen pos〈kye'aphrul bstan pas/ /sems can rnams la rgya cher ni/ /'jig rten zhen7pa rab smad delta/ /zhen pa mi skyed 6nyid du mdzad/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan pas/ /sems can rnams la rgya cher ni/ /'jig rten rnyed pa rab smad de / /'dus ma byas kyi bsngags ri brjod mdzad/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul58)bstan pas/ /sems can rnams la rgya cher ni/ /zag bcas shes pa rab smad de / /zag med shes rab bsngags par 9mdzad/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan pas/ /sems can rnams la rgya cher ni/ /'jig rten bsam gtan rab smad de/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i ting 'dzin bsngags/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan pasasna / /sems can rnams la rgya 11cher ni/ /zag bcas tshul khrims rab smad de12/ /zag med bslab gnas skyo bsngags par mdzad/ /thugs rje chen pos 1 'phrul bstan pasam/ /sems can rnams la rgya cher ni/ /sems rgya chung ngu'i 10skyon 1 brjod de/ /sems rgya chen po'i yon tan bsngags/ /thugs rje chen pos snana'aphrul bstan nas19/ /lus kyi tshul khrims sems shes rab/ /zag med rten pa 2 med pa yi/ /bsngags pa dag ni brjod par mdzad/ /40wa 650

thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan nas3)/ /sdug bsngal 'gog pa'i lam bsngags shing ske/ /spros la dga' zhing zhen pa dag /sangs rgyas smad par b.rab tu bstan / /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan nasatsho ri/ /sems can rnams la rgya cher ni/ / mig zad〈geskyon ni rab 'byed cing / /rab zhi5gematshan nyid bstan par mdzad/ /rna ba sna lce lus dang yid/ /gzugs sgra dri ro ri noreg bya nas/ /sgra dang ming gi bar du yang / /thams cad de bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan nas/ /sems can rnams la rgya cher ni/ /dar la bab cing gzhon pa la/ /nyes dmigs dpag med yod par bstan/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan nasani/ /sems can rnams la rgya cher ni/ /cho rigs dag ni snyems7pa la/ /nyes dmigs dpag med yod par bstan/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan nas7/ /sems can rnams la rgya cher ni/ /longs spyod bag51med gyur pa la/ /nyes dmigs dpag med yod par bstan/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan nas/ /sems can rnams la rgya cher ni/ /rang dbang bag med gyur pa la/ /nyes dmigs dpag med yod par bstan/ /thugs rje chen pos de'aphrul bstan nas/ /sems can rnams la rgya cher ni/ /gzugs kyis nyartebag med gyur pa la/ /nyes dmigs dpag med yod par bstan/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan nas/ /sems can rnams la rgya cher ni/ /bud med bag med gyur pa la/ /nyes dmigs dpag med yod par bstan/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan nas/ /sems can rnams la rgya cher ni/ /gos kyis bebag med gyur pa la/ /nyes dmigs dpag med yod par bstan/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan nas/ /sems can rnams la rgya cher ni/ /chang gis 48—651

bag med gyur pa la/ /nyes dmigs dpag med yod par bstan/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan nas/ /sems can rnams la rgya cher ni/ /rgyal po bag med gyur pa la/ /nyes dmigs dpag med yod par bstan/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan nas17/ /sems can rnams la rgya cher ni/ /tshul khrims snyems ri par gyur pa la/ /nyes dmigs dpag med yod par bstan/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan nas/ /sems can rnams la rgya cher ni/ /shes rab snyems par gyur pa la/ /nyes dmigs dpag med yod par bstan/ /de bzhin rtogs dang ༄rdzu 'phrul dang / /bsam gtan mkhas pa'i nga rgyal dang / /nor dang bshad dang rigs dang 'khor/ /rol mo glu dunadang lce rgyangasredang / /grags pa phun dzotshogs bsngags pa 8)dang / /bkur ste nyu)dang ni rnyed pa dang / /mdzes dang g.yo sgyu nga rgyal dang / /ngo tsha med dang khrel med dang / /khengs dang phun tshogs nga rgyal dang / /bag med 'dod chags de bzhin no/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan nas/ /sems can gang zhig sems dang yid/ /dman par gyur pa de dag la/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i 'du shes bstan/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan nas/ /sems can gang zhig rab zhum zhing / /rtsol bar mi byed de dag la/ /brtson 'grus stobs ni ston par mdzad/ /thugs rje chen pos 'phrul bstan nas/ /sems can gang zhig nor 1 ༷rnams la/ /chags par gyur pa de dag la/ /chog 11shes chos ni ston par mdzad/na/ /gzhan yang spos kyi dri gtsang khang 1 / /me tog dag ni 1 cigazhal med khang / /khang pa brtsegs bom mchog sprul nas/ /sprul pa'i sangs rgyas bzhugs par bstan/ /gzhan yang lha yi bu mo rnams/ /me tog tsam pa 17khang pa na/ /gnas pa'i nyurte48—652

lus phyed mngon0)sprul nas/ /me tog phreng du thogs mchod byed bstan/ /gzhan yang lha min bu mo dag /me tog ma lim khang pa na/ /gnas pa 4lus phyed bstan sprul nas/ /me tog phreng tshor)thogs mchod byed bstan/ /gzhan yang lha yi bu rnams dag⑥ /pad ma sngon po'i khang pa na mu/ /gnas paran lus phyed bstan sprulashenas/ /sangs rgyas yon tan bsngags pa bstan/ /gzhan yang tshangs pa rnams kyi lha/ /gser gyi gzhal med khang pa na/ /gnas pa71 )lus kun bstan sprularwatenas/ /sgra snyan sangs rgyas bsngags pa bstan/ /gzhan yang lha yi bu mo dag /sna tshogs rgyan gyisatshwa lus brgyan cing nyan/ /rgyan ni phan tshun reg 7pa las / /sgra snyan dag ni rab byung nas/ /'dus byas rnams kyi chos dag ni/ /'gyur zhing mami brtanam yin na yang / /byis pa mi bden rtog hu 7pa yis yang dag ji bzhin mi shes zer/ /rgyan gyi sgra ni de dag kyang / /lus dang sems las byung mtshwa)yin/ /'gro ba med cing 'ong ba med/ /phyogs kyang yod pa ma yin te/ /gzugs dang sems kyi bar du yang / /thams cad de bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /byis pa rnams ni mi shes huXpas/ /'di la the tshom skye bar 'gyur / /rgyan gyi rnamadza 1pa de dag las/ /sgra snyan ni byung ba de yis ni/ /sangs rgyas zhing tsho lhakun grags pas na/ /sems can tshad med grol bar gyur/ /de lta bas na khyod 2 rnams kyis/ /'dren pa'i nigerang byung ye shes dang / /yon tan dpag med sku dag ni/ /sred pa'i spros las 'das pa dang / /rab dben skyon ni med pa dang ske/ /lta bral sems ni rab sbyangs dang / /mtshan dang dpe byad brgyan pa dang ske/ /sku dang thugs ni dag par ltos/ /khyed kyis bcom ldan grong phyogashegs 3 tshe / /gom pa dag ni seng ge 'dra/ /gshegs stabs ngang 2 pa glang chen 'dra/ /40wa 653

sems can re ba skong7)bar mdzad/ /bsod nams khyad 'phags yongs su rdzogs / /yang dag mtshan gyis rab tu brgyan/ /sems can dag ni thams cad kun / /ltadza bas mi ngoms nyid du ltos/ /khyodasakyis rkang gnyis gtso yi mchog(4 /thugs rje chen po ldan pas0na/ /dngos po chung ngus mchod byas kyang ske/ /yon tan tshad med 'thobalgemadzad pas/ /sems can dag ni mang po rnams / /bskal pa brgya stong mang por ni/ /mya ngan 'das pa 'thobashebar du/ /rnamadzashasmin thug pa med par ltos/ /khyed kyis 9)rkang gnyis gtso mchog ni/ /zag med tshul khrims rdzogasasgro pas na/ /sems can dag ni mang po rnams/ /gus pas spyi bos77phyag byed dang / /lha yi 'khor ni mang po rnams/ /so so'isnyigazhal med khang spangs nasahurte/ /rtse ba dag la chags med par/ /'dren pa la ni rten 8byed ltos/ /khyed kyis bdud dang bdud kyi 'khor/ /bcom ldan 'das la dad skyes minas/ /gser gyi rlung yab dag thogs 7te/ /g.yas g.yon du hu ni 'khod pa dang / /nyugebadud kyi bu ni lnga57brgya yis/ /lha yi me tog yid 'ong bas/ /de bzhin gshegs la mngon gtor nas/ /bla med ye shes tshol la ltosadu ri/ /'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la ni/ /bsngags pa brjod cing mchod pas na/ /deng zhunyani bcom ldan phrad gyur nas/ /so sor trigedaga' bar gyur pa yin/ /spobs pa dag ni tshad med kyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bsngags pa brjod/ /de yi tshe na bdud kyi bu/ /srid (rtepa spangs pa zhes bya ba/ /thog mar bcom ldan bsngags brjod nas/ /mig zad mtha' ni shes par gyur/ /mig gi skyes mumatha' shes pa nasazhuge/ /rab zhi (sumatshan nyid bar du rtogs/ /gzhan yang mig zad la sogs pa'i/ /mig ni tshodon dag ni〈shedapag med rtogs/ /40wa 654

des nanyetshig mkhasasridag gis ni/ /sems can rnams la yang dag bstan/ /mingasnyedang don rnams la yang ni/ /zhen dang〈bethe tshom med pas na/ /'gro 'ong med par rab rtogs shing / /blang dor med pa nyid du gyur/ /rang bzhin dag ni stong dben pas/ /yi ge rnams ni spangs pa dang / /len dang 'dzin5lde)dang klog pa dang / /kha ton7'don cing sgrub medakyirtogs/ /'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs rnams kyisal/ /sngon yang rab tu phye ste〈)bstan/ /btags pa'i ming tsam yin pas na/ /yang dag brjod du ci yang med/ /rang bzhin stong pa de dag ni⑩/ /phung po khams dang skye mched 'das/ /brdzunatshwanyepa med cing bden pa'ang〈nyemed/ /gnas dang gnas pa yod pa min(rte/ /tshig gis7smra ba'i lam chad cing / /sems kyi spyod pa'ang rab tu zhi/ /skye bo'i 7mtshan ma zhen nyi 7pa'i phyir / /bcom ldan grong khyer gshegs par mthongate/na/ /bcom ldan mtshan ma yongs spangs kyang / /byis pa yang dag ma yin rtogazhu) /bcom ldan grong khyer gshegs pa'ikhu tshe/ /gang zhig dga' ba skye 'gyur ba(1/ /de ni zhugematshan mar rtog pa ste/ /mya ngan gdung du snyedang bcas par 'gyur( mi/ /gang gis 25mtshan ma'i rtog spangs pas/ /grong khyer gshegs pa mthong mi 'gyur/ /gshegs shing bskyod pa'i mtshan ma la/ /rnam rtog med pa'i ni shes rab 'thobazhun/ /gang gis mtshan mar sangs rgyas mthong / /des ni grong khyer gshegs pa 3rtomathong ske/ /skye zhing 'khor ba'i chos dag la/ /rnam par rtog pa skyedamu )par byed/ /gang gis sangs rgyas mtshan mar mthong / / dga' ba dgamanyani skye 'gyur ba/ /de ni bdud kyi spyod la gnas/ /bdud kyi spyod yul snang ba yin/ /gang gis mtshan mar sangs rgyas mthong / /de ni 'gyur ba mthong ba yin/ /de ni mya ngan 48wa 655

gdungs bcas pas1 / /mkhas pas snying brtser dun/bya ba yin/ /chos la thob par gang lta ba/ /de la chos storam mya ngan yod/ /sangs rgyas mthong ba geskyesam2pa la/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i sdug bsngal yod/ /bskal pa mang po5nyagang bsgoms pas ri/ /mtshan ma thams cad rtogs pas napo)/ /grong khyer gshegs par 9mi rtog cing 7/ /mya ngan 'da' ba'i 31'du shes med/ /sems kyi mtshan nyid stong rtogs pa12/ /sangs rgyas spyod la gnas pas na/ /grong khyer gshegs7rtepar mi rtog cing / /mya ngan 'das pa'i mi'adu shes med/ /gang gis de ltar rab shes pa / /sangs rgyas rnams ni mthong 'gyur zhing / /ngo bo nyid kyang stong rtogs pas8/ /mthar ni skye 'gag ci yang med/ /bcom ldan bskal pa dpag med nas/ /dka' ba rnams ni rab spyad nas/ /ngo bo nyid ni stong mkhyen na/ /byis pa rnams tsho kyis mi rtogs so/ /bcom ldan grong khyer gshegs pa'i tshe/ /'khor ni brgya stong mang gis nyu8bskor/ /mi dang mi ma yin la hu'esogasal/ /dang ba'i sems kyi ri ci rimachod pa bas(1/ /gang gis skad cig tsam du ni//mig zad mtha' sa ni rab sems shing / /mtshan ma rnams ni stong rtogs du rten/ /'di yi ri ribasod nams de bas 'phags/ /bgrang ba dang ni grangs kyi cha(snye/ /rgyu tsam du yang mi bzod do/ /de bzhin mig gi skye mtha' dang / /mig gi mtha' dang 'jug pa nas/ /rab tu zhi ba'i bar du yang / /de bzhin du ni rig (6par bya / /rna ba sna lce lus dang yid/ /gzugs sgra dri ro na reg bya nas/ /sgra dang ming gi bar du yang / /thams cad de bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /de nas de tshe bcom ldan 'dasas / /grong khyer du ni gshegs pa'i tshe/ /zhabs ni sa la reg tsam gyis/ /sa ni kun tu rab tu g.yos/ /ri rnams gang yin de dag kyang / /48wa 656

thams cad bcom ldan 'das la phyogs/ /lha dang mi 3)ni chos kyi phyir/ /thams cad 'ongasashenas gus mchod byas/ /de nas de tshe bcom ldan 'das/ /grong khyer du ni gshegs pa'i tshe/ /lha yi dbang po mi yi rgyal/ /lha ma yin ni mang po dang / /gnod sbyin dag ni mang po rnams/ /rang gi grong khyer spangs nas ni/ /bcom ldan spyan sngar 'dus gyur te/ /rab tu dga' bas mchod pa byas / /de nas de tshe bcom ldan 'das/ /grong khyer du ni gshegs pa'i tshe/ /gzhan yang rnam pa tha dad pa'i/ /bya yi tshogs ni tshad med pa/ /ne tso dang ni rma bya dang / /ka la ping ka bya yir rnams/ /bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa yi / /yon tan mchog ni mthong bas na/ /thams cad nam mkha' dag la ni/ /rab tu dga' bas rnam par rtse/ /thams cad rnam pa sna tshogs kyi55/ /sgra snyan dag ni rab tu phyung / /de nas 5)de tshe bcom ldan 'das/ /grong khyer du ni gshegs pa'i tshe/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi 577yon tan dang / /rdzu 'phrul gyi ni stobs dag gis/ /sems can tshad med 8brgya stong snyed/ / ldongs pa 9)dag ni mthong bar gyur/ /'on pa rnams nya rini thos par gyur/ /dbang po ma tshang kyi k+kogang yin pa/ /thams cad dbang po tshang bar nyu2gyur/ /sdug bsngal la ni gnas pa dag /thams cad bde ba thob par gyur/ /de nas de tshe bcom ldan 'das / /grong khyer du ni gshegs pa'i tshe/ /nam mkha' bar snang dag las nyusnyeni / /'di skad smra ba thos par gyur/ /gang gis mtshan ma rnams kyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rtogasam byed pa/ /de yis bcom ldan 'das la ni/ /mchod pa byasashezhes brjod mi bya/ /mig zad mtha' yi ngo bo nyid/ /rtogs par yang ni mi 'gyur ro/ /mtshan ma rnams ni gang spangs pa/ /yon tan bzhi tshani 48wa 657

bsags pas na/ /mig zad mtha' yi ngo bo nyid/ /rab tu rtogs par yang 'gyur ro/ /'di ltar mig ni zad pa'i mtha'/ /rab tu rtogs par gyur pa'i phyir / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi yon tan yang / /rab tu rtogs par khong du chud//mig ni zad pa'i mtha' dag la/ /mi 'dzin sbed pa med pa dang / /mig ni skye ba'i mtha' dag la/ /rtenatucing gnas pa med pa dang / /mig ni rab tu dben pa la/ /g.yo ba'i bsam pa med gyur pa/ /des ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnamasal/ /mthong ba nyid du gyur pa yin/ /mig ni skye ba'i mtha' dag la/ /rnam par rtog pa med pa dang / /mig gi mtha' ni gang yin pa/ /de la yid kyi rtogadzaXmed dang / /mig ni rnams par 'jig pa la/ /bstan par bya ba med gyur pa/ /des ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /mthong ba nyid du gyur pa yin / /mig ni med par gyur pa la/ /mngon par zhen pa med pa dang / /mig ni skye ba med pa las/ /yongs su sdud pa med pa dang / /mig ni rab tu zhi ba la / /'dzin pa dag ni med gyur pa/ /des ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /mthong ba nyid du gyur pa yin(ge/ /mig ni zad par shes pa'i phyir/ /mtshan rnams mngon par bsgrubartsomapa dang / /mig gi mtha' ni shes pa'i phyir/ /dbang po dag duni nges gyur dang / /mig ni skye ba shes pa'i phyir/ /dbang po rang dbang thob ()gyur pa/ /des hubye ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /mthong ba nyid du gyur pa yin/ /mig ni med par rtogs gyur nas(lha/ /gzugs ni khong du chud pa dang / /mig ni 'jig par rab shes nas/ /chos la so sor rtogatsos dang ske/ /mig ni skye med shes gyur nas/ /lam ni sgrub hunyepar gang byed pa/ /des ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /mthong ba nyid du gyur pa yin/ /mig 40wa 658

zad mtha' ni gang yin pa/ /yang dag ji bzhin rtogs pa'i phyir/ /las kyi bye brag tha dad pa/ /de yang rab tu rtogs 7par 'gyur/ /las kyi bye brag tha dad pa/ /rab tu rtogs par gyur pa'i phyir/ /des ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams / /mthong ba nyid du 'gyur ba yin/ /mig skye mtha' ni gang yin pa/ /yang〈dag ji bzhin rtogs pa'i phyir/ /sdug bsngal bye brag tha dad pa/ /de yang rab tu rtogs par 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal bye brag tha dad pa/ /rab tu rtogs par gyur pa'i phyir/ /des ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /mthong ba nyid du gyur pa yin/ /mig gi 'jigashepa gang yin pa/ /yang dag ji bzhin rtogs pa'i phyir/ /sdug bsngal 'jig ④pa gang yin pa/ /de yang rab tu rtogs par 'gyur/ /sdug bsngal 'jig (snyepa gang yin pa/ /rab tu rtogs par gyur pa'i phyir⑥/ /des ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /mthong ba nyid du gyur pa —yin / /mig gi med pa gang yin pa/ /yang dag ji bzhin rtogs pa'i phyir/ /mtshan ma spangs pa gang yin pa/ /de yang rab tu rtogs par 'gyur/ /mtshan ma spangs pa gang yin pa/ /rab tu rtogs par gyur pa'i phyir/ /des ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /mthong ba nyid du gyur pa yin/ /mig gi skye med gang yin pa/ /yang dag ji bzhin rtogs pa'i phyir/ /bag chags spangs pa gang yin pa/ /de yang rab tu rtogs par 'gyur/ /bag chags spangs pa gang yin pa/ /rab tu rtogs par gyur pa'i phyir/ /des ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams / /mthong ba nyid du gyur pa yin/ /gzhan yang mig gi mi rtog nyid/ /yang dag ji bzhin rtogs pa'i phyir/ /sgrib pa spangs pa gang yin pa/ /de yang rab tu rtogs par 'gyur/ / sgrib pa spangs pa gang yin pa/ /zhu)rab tu rtogs 40wa 659

par gyur pa'i phyir/ /des ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /mthong ba nyid du gyur pa yin/ /gzhan yang mig la yi ge med/ /yang dag ji bzhin rtogs pa'i phyir/ /sangs rgyas ye shes stobs dag kyang / /rab tu rtogs par gyur pa yin / /sangs rgyas ye shes stobs dag ni/ /rab tu rtogs par 7gyur pa'i phyir / /des ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /mthong ba nyid du gyur pa yin/ /gzhan yang mig gi mi 'ongs cinyid/ /yang dag ji bzhin rtogs pa'i phyir/ /'dod rnams spangs pa gang yin pa/ /de yang rab tu rtogs par gyur/ /'dod rnams spangs pa gang yin pa/ /rab tu rtogs par gyur pa'i phyir/ /des ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /mthong ba nyid du gyur pa yin/ / gzhan yang cabasam gtan bsgom 5pa dag /yang dag ji bzhin rtogs pa'i phyir/ / nyon mongs spongs 46 pa gang yin pa/ / de yang rab tu rtogs par 'gyur/ / nyon mongs spangs pa gang yin pa/ /myurab tu rtogs par gyur pa'i phyir/ /des ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams/ /mthong ba nyid du gyur pa yin/ /gang zag des ni de bzhin du/ /mig gi sngon ⑧mtha' shes pa dang / /mig gi 3)mi gnas shes pa dang / /mig gi skye ba nyu rishes pa dang / /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul shes pa dang ske/ /mig gi dman pa shes pa dang / /mig gi 37khyad par 'phags shes hu dang ske/ /ye shes dman pa shes pa dang / /rnam dag ye shes shes pa dang / /tshul khrims rnam dag shes pa dang / /lus kyi sdom pa'i 1 shes pa dang / /rnam dag sgra yi shes pa dang / /ngag gi sdom pa'i geshes pa dang / /rnam dag sems kyi shes pa dang / /gnas kyi bye brag shes pa dang / /sems kyi chos kyi shes pa dang ske/ /sems skyon mashes pa'i shes pa dang / /rnam dag las kyi shes pa dang / /48wa 660

bosems kyi sdom pa'i0)shes pa dang / /nyes dmigs shes pa'i shes pa dang / /rnam dag sgra yi shes pa dang / /phung po'i bye brag shes pa dang / /phung po'i rgyu rkyen shes pa dang / /mig ni yongs shes shes pa dang / /sdug bsngal 'byung gnas shes pa dang / /zag med tshul khrims shes pa dang / /tshul khrims rgyu rkyen shes pa dang / /sdug bsngal rgyu rkyen shes pa dang / /sdug bsngal zad pa'i rgyu shesasnyedang / /'dus byas rnams kyi shes pa dang / / zag pa zad pa'i gshes pa dag④ /yongs su rdzogs par byed 55)pa yin/ /gzhan yang rgyu rkyen bcu gnyis kyi0rka/ /spyod mdang bcas pa'i shes pa dang / /spyod padza med pa'i shes pa dang / /mtshan ma bcas dngashematshan ma med/ /'dus byas dang ni 'dus ma byas/ /rnam par gzhagatshwa )dang yongs sdud dang / /bdag dang gzhan gyi sems shes pa/nyu//yang dag ji bzhin shes pa yin32/ /gzhan yang mig zad skye mtha' dang kyisnye/ /mig gi mtha' dang rab dben dang / /'jug pa dang ni med pa dang / /mi skye ba dang nyer zhi nyid/ /yang dag ji bzhin shes pas na / /sems can dag ni mang po rnams/ /rnam par dag pa'i ye shes dang / /mthu dang bcas pa'i ye shes dang / /brtson 'grus ye shes 'thob 8par byed/ /gzhan yang gcig dang tha dad shes/ /sems can dag ni thams cad kyitsha/ /mos pa'i shes /rtepa gang yin pa/ /yang dag ji nyunyebazhin shes pa yin3)/ /gzhan yang sems can thams cad kyi/ /mos pa khyad par 'phags pa dang / /rnam dag sems kyi shes pa dang du ༷ / /las dang rnam smin shes pa dang / /dbang po khams kyi shes pa dang / /sems kyi 'gyur ba shes pa dang / /shes rab mos pa'i du rtoshes pa dang / /shin tu rnam grol shes pa dang / /spobs pa mchog gi shes pa dag rte/ yang dag ji 40wa 661

bzhin shes pa yin༅kā/ /gzhan yang sems can ma rungs dang / /chos la mos pa med gyur pa/ /yang dag ji bzhin shes pas na/ /mos pa'i⑧zhes pa skyedakhupar byed/ /gzhan yang don gyi tshul dag ni/ /yang dag ji bzhin shes pas na//le lo med pa'i shes pa dag /dus7shes sgrub par byed pa yin/ /gzhan yang rdzu 'phrul stobs dag gis/ /chos rnams rab tu 'byed pa dang / /thogs pa med pa'i ye shes dag /yang dag ji bzhin shes pa yin/ /gzhan yang rgya chenaphudon dag dang / /tshig gis bstan pa gang yin pa/ /rjes su shes pa'i shes pa dag /yang dag ji bzhin shes pa yin/ /gzhan yang grogs bzang 'thun gnas dang / /gos dang zas dang btung ba dag /tshod shes pa yi7shes pa rnams / /yang dag ji bzhin shes pa yin/ /gzhan yang bya ba med pa yi/ /gzugs kyi chos ni gang yin pa(ge/ /nan tan bsgrubalgepa'i shes pa dag /yang dag ji bzhin shes pa yin/ /gzhan yang lus sems skyon med cing / /sgro 'dogs skur 'debs yongs spangs nas/ /bla med ye shes gang tshol ba/ /yang dag ji bzhin shes pa yin/ /gzhan yang rdzu 'phrul stobs dag gis/ /nam mkha' bar snang dag las ni/ /sprul pa'i sku ni rab bstan nas/ /sems can dag ni brgya stong snyed/nya/ /yongs su smin par mdzad pas na/ /thams cad rab tu dga' gyur nas/ / dad pa 3)skyes pa'i shes pa dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la yang / /mos shing hunyegus pa'i shes pa dang / /'dod chags spangs 8pa'i chos dag la/ /rab mos bsgrubam pa'i shes pa dang / /'phags pa'i dge 'dun tshogs la yang / /mchod par mos pa'i shes pa dang / /byang chub chen po dag la yang / /rab mos bsngo ba'i shes pa dang / /gzungasalge48—662

rnams kyi ni sgo dag la/ /rab mos ston pa'i shes pa dang / /mos pa rnams ni gang yin pa/ /so sor rab rtogs shes pa dang / /'phags pa'i ting 'dzin gang yin pa/ /legs par rtogs pa'i shes pa dang / /bsrungs)༄dang rjes su dran rnams la/ /nges par byed ②pa'i shes pa dang / /dpag tu med pa'i sems dag la/ /legs par 'jug pa'i shes pa dang57/ /tshigs su bcad pa tshad med rnams/ /yang dag ston pa'i shes pa dang / /'dod pa'i mtshamasa'agesbyor gang yin pa/ /rtogs shing go ba'i shes pa dang / /'gro ba dman pa de dag tu/ /ltung bar mi 'gyur shes pa dang / /mi dge sribashes gnyen gang yin pa / /yongs su spong57byed shes pa dang / /dge ba'i bshes gnyen gang yin pa/ /stenashepar byed pa'i shes pa dang / /'dri zhing lan ldon gang yin pa/ /rab tu rnam 'byed shes pa dang / /gnas dang gnas min gang yin pa/ /legs par rtogs pa'i shes pa dang / /sa dang sa min gang yin pa/ /legs par rtogs pa'i shes pa dang / /rab 'bring tha ma gang yin pa/ /rnam par 'byed pa'i shes pa dang / /'dus byas shes pa gang yin dang58)/ /'dus ma byas kyi shes pa dang ske/ /dngos po dang ni rdzas kyi shes/ /dngos dang rdzas min shes pa dang / /yongs su sdud byed shes pa dang / /yongs su sdud min shes pa dang / /mngon par sgrub7pa'i shes pa dang / /3 )yang dag sgrubarwa1min shes pa dang / /mig dang mig min shes pa dang / /mig dang lhan cig shes pa dang / /mig gi bye brag shes pa dang / /mig gi rang bzhin shes pa dang hurte/ /yang dag ji bzhin shes pa yin8/ /rna ba sna lce lus nas ni/ /sgra dang ming la sogs pa'i bar/ /chos ni rnam pa nyi shu lnga/ /thams cad de bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /gang zhig mig 40wa 663

gi rgyu rkyen nyid/ /yang dag stong zhing dben pa dang / /mthar ni bdagatuyod ma yin par / /sems par byed pa gang yin pa/ /gang zag des ni de bzhin dul/ /yang dag nges pa kho nar ni/ /sems kyi ting 'dzin gang yin pa/ /yongs su rdzogs par byed par 'gyur/ /gang zhig mig gi rten 'brel dang / /mig mi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid dgas/ /nges pa nyid du rtogs gyur nasasti/ /sems par 3)byed pa gang yin pa/ /gang zag des ni de bzhin du/ /mig gi rgyu rkyen gang yin dang 46/ /mthar ni yod pa ma yin parim/ /yang dag ji bzhin rtogs par 'gyur/ /rna ba sna lce lus nas ni/ /sgra dang ming la58)sogs pa'i bar / /chos ni rnam pa nyi shu lnga/ /thams cadang9)de bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /de yi tshe na bcom ldan 'das/ /grong khyer du ni gshegs pa'i tshe/ /zhabs ni sa la reg tsam gyis/ /dngos po ngo mtshar nyu cirab bstan pa/ /deng 'dir bdag gi mdor bsdus 11nas/ /yon tan phyogs ni cung zad cig/sems can dga' ba bskyed pa'i 12phyir/ /yang dag par ni bstan nya par bya/ /de tshe lha midza8'dren pa yis/ /spu yi khung bu gcig nas ni/ /'od zer brgya stong tshad med snyedaski/ /rab tu bkye bar gyur pas na/ /'od zer dag ni re res kyang / /zhing ni tshad med gsal mdzad nas/ /sems can mang po kun gyi phyir/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa rab tu mdzad/ /gang zhig 'das pa'i dus su ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa dang / /yun ring sbyin dang tshul khrims dgaḥzhe /mngon nyu par bsgrubs 1 pa gang yin pa/ /de lta bu yi gang zag dag /des ni ji 17skad bstan pa yi/ /rdzu 'phrul dngos po thos 3 —gyur na/ /rab tu dga' zhing mos par 'gyur/ /gang zhig sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul rnams/ /nyan thos dang ni rang rgyal gyi/ /spyod yul 40wa 664

min7par rab shes nas/ /de lta bu yi gang zag dgan) /des ni jim skad bstan pa yi/ /rdzu 'phrul dag nine༄thos gyur na/ /mos pa dag ni skye 'gyur zhing ske/ /ngo mtshar 'dzin pa'i sems kyang skyed(5)/ /lha dang mi ni 'dren pa yis/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mthu dag gis/ /de lta bu la sogs pa 467/ /rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs rab bstan pasal/ /sems can dag ni brgya stong dang / /tshad med grangs med pa durnams kyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams la ni/ /bsten cing rim gro mchod pa byas/ /lha dang mi ni59)'dren pa yis/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mthu dag gis/ /mdo sde dag ni brgya stong dang / /tshad med grangs med rab bshad pas/ /sems can dag ni mang po rnams/ /bstan pa de ni thos pas na/ /thams cad dang bas rab blangs te/ /sems ni rab tu dga' bar gyur / /de yi tshe na bcom ldan 'das/ /grong khyer du ni gshegs pa'i tshe3 ) /rdzu 'phrul gyi ni mthu dag gis/ /nam mkha' las ni 'di skad du/ /mig zad mtha' ni shes pa nasathem/ /732mig ni nye bar zhi ba dang / /mig nyid rgyu yi hurtebar du yang / /'gro ba med cing 'ong bomed dang / /mthar ni stong dben shes par gyis/ /de skad du ni mthos par gyur/ /rna kheb sna lce lus nas ni/ /sgra dang ming la sogs pa'i bar/ /chos ni rnam pa nyi shu lnga/ /thams cad de bzhin sbyar bar bya/ /de yi tshe na bcom ldan 'das/ /grong khyer du ni gshegs pa'i tshe / /nam mkha' bar snang dag las ni/ /sgra snyan dam pa mchog byung nas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan sna tshogs/ / bsngags pa brjod par 3 gyur pas na / /'khor ni 'dus nyunyepa chen po rnams/ /thams cad dad mos sems kyang skyes/zhe / /da ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa yi / /mi yi seng ge gang yin pa/ /48wa 665

mtshan ni bdud dang 3)bdud dpung dag /phamasamadzad chos kyi rgyal zhes bya/ /gang gis 'di lta bu yi mtshan/ /thos par gyur pa de dag ni/ /log par lta ba'i tshogs thams cad/ /rab tu 'dul bar nus shes zer/ /da7ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa yi/ /mi yi seng ge gang yin pa/ /mtshan ni7'dod chags gzhom pa dang / /zhi mdzad chos kyi rgyal zhes bya/ /gang gis 'di lta bu yi mtshan / /thos par gyur pa de dag nigye/ /'dod pa'i 'dod chags gang yin pa / /thams cad spong bar 'gyur zhes zer/ /da ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa yi / /mi yi seng ge gang yin pa/ /mtshan ni zhe snang gzhom7pa dang / /zhi mdzad chos kyi9)rgyal zhes bya/ /gang gis 'di lta bu yi mtshan/ /thos par gyur pa de dag ni/ / zhe snang dag ni gang yin pa/ /thams cad spong bar 'gyur zhes zer/ /da ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa yi/ /mi yi seng ge gang yin pa/ /mtshan ni gti mug gzhom pa dang / /zhi mdzad chos kyi rgyal zhes bya/ /gang gis 'di lta bu yi mtshan/ /thos par gyur pa de dag ni/ /gan)gti mug dag ni gang yin pa/ /thams cad spong bar 'gyur zhes zer/ /da ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa yi/ /mi yi seng ge gang yin pa/ /mtshan nisheng rgyal gzhom / ripa dang / /zhi mdzad chos kyi rgyal zhes bya/ /gang gis 'di lta bu yi mtshan/ /thos par gyur pa de dag ni/ /nga rgyal dag ni gang yin pa/ /thams cad spong bar 'gyur zhes zer / /da ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa yi/ /mi yi seng ge gang yin pa/ /mtshan ni khong khro gzhom 114pa dang / /zhi mdzad chos kyi rgyal zhes bya/ /gang gis 'di lta bu yi mtshan/ /thos par gyur pa de dag ni/ /khong khro hurtedag ni gang yin pa / /thams cad spong bar 'gyur zhes zer/ /da ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa 40wa 666

yi / /mi yi seng ge gang yin pa/ /mtshan ni phrag dog gzhom0)pa dang / /zhi mdzad chos kyi rgyal zhes gya②/ /gang gis 'di lta bu yi mtshan/ /thos par gyur pa de dag ni/ /phrag dog dag ni gang yin pa/ /thams cad spong bar 'gyur zhes zer③/ /da ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa yi/ /mi yi seng ge gang yin pa/ /mtshan ni mi bden gzhom pa dang / /0zhi mdzad chos kyi rgyal zhes bya/ /gang gis 'di lta bu yi mtshan/ /thos par gyur pa de dag ni/ / mi bden dag nipo)gang yin pa/ /thams cad spong bar 'gyur zhes zer/ /da ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa yi/ /mi yi seng ge gang yin pa/ /mtshan ni lta7rnams gzhom 3)pa dang ske/ /zhi mdzad chos kyi rgyal zhes bya/ /gang gis 'di lta bu yi mtshan/ /thos par gyur pa de dag ni/ /lta ba dag ni gang yin pa/ /thams cad spong bar 'gyur zhes zer/ /da ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa yi/ /mi yi seng ge gang yin pa / /mtshan ni spros pa gzhom pa dang / /zhi mdzad chos kyi rgyal zhes bya/ /gang gis7'di lta bu yi mtshan/ /thos par gyur pa de dag ni/ /spros pa dag ni gang yin pa/ /thams cad spong bar 'gyur zhes zer/ /da ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa yi/ /mi yi seng ge gang yin pa/ /mtshan ni yang dag pa yi chos/ /rnam〈)dag chos kyi rgyal zhes bya/ /gang gis 'di lta bu yi mtshan/ /thos par gyur pa de dag ni/ /rnam dag chos ni nyu 3gang yin pa/ /rab tu rtogs par 'gyur zhes zer / /da ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa yi/ /mi yi seng ge gang yin pa/ /mtshan ni las rnams rtogs pa yi/ /dzomachos kyi rgyal zhes bya ba yin(nye/ /gang gis 'di lta bu yi mtshan/ /thos par gyur pa de dag ni/ /las rnams thams cad gang yin pa/ /rab tu rtogs par 'gyur zhes zer/ /da ltar 'jig rten 40wa 667

bzhugs pa yi/ /mi yi seng ge gang yin pa/ /mtshan ni rdzu 'phrul phun tshogs pa'i / /chos kyi rgyal zhes bya ba yin/ /gang gis 'di lta bu yi mtshan/ /thos par gyur pa de dag ni/ /rdzu 'phrul yon tan gang yin pa/ /yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur zhes zer/ /da ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa yi/ /mi yi seng ge gang yin pa/ /mtshan ni pha rol phyin pa rnams/ /phun tshogs chos kyi rgyal zhes bya/ /gang gis 'di lta bu 1yi mtshan/ /thos par gyur pa de dag ni/ /pha rol phyin drug gang yin pa/ /yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur zhes zer/ /da ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa yi/ /mi yi seng ge gang yin pa/ /mtshan ni 'du byed gang yin pa / /rab rtogs chos kyi rgyal zhes bya/ /gang gis 'di lta bu yi mtshan/ /'dzin par byed pa de dag ni/ /'du byed dag ni thams cad kun/ /rab tu rtogs par 'gyur zhes zer/ /da ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa yi/ /mi yi seng ge gang yin pa/ /mtshan ni rnam par dag pa yin/ /'od zer kun 'dzin skyed ces bya / /gang gis 'di lta bu yi mtshan/ /thos par gyur pa de dag ni/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i skye len dag /yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur zhes zer/ /da ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa yi/ /mi yi seng ge gang yin pa/ /mtshan ni kha dog dag pa yi / /'od zer kun 'dzin zhes kyang bya/ /gang gis 'di lta bu yi mtshan / /thos par gyur pa de dag ni/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i gzugs dam pa / /yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur zhes zer/ /da ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa yi / /mi yi seng ge gang yin pa/ /mtshan ni sku nyid dag 5pa yi / /'od zer kun 'dzin zhes kyang bya/ /gang gis 'di lta bu yi mtshan/ /thos par gyur pa de dag ni/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i gzugs sku dag /yongs su rdzogs par (1wa 668

'gyur zhes zer/ /da ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa yi/ /mi yi seng ge gang yin pa / /mtshan ni gdung nyid dag pa yi/ /'od zer kun 'dzin zhes kyang bya/ /gang gis 'di lta bu yi mtshan/ /thos par gyur pa de dag ni/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i rus rigs rnams/ /yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur zhes zer/ /da ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa yi/ /mi yi seng ge gang yin pa/ /mtshan ni rgya cher grags pa yi/ /'od zer kun 'dzin zhes kyang bya/ /gang gis 'di lta bu yi mtshan / /thos par gyur pa de dag ni/ /rgya cher grags pa'i01grags pa rnams/ /yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur zhes zer/ /da ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa yi/ /mi yi seng ge gang yin pa/ /mtshan ni sbyin pa gtong ba dang / /tshul khrims can dang bzod bsgomasaphudang / /brtson 'grus brtsams dang bsamakhugatan dang bya/ /shes rab kun 'dzin zhes kyang bya/ /gang gis 'di lta bu yi mtshan/ /thos par gyur pa de dag ni/ /sbyin pa dang ni tshul khrims nas/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa dang / /gzungs kyi sgo ni gang yin pa/ /yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur zhes zer/ /da ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa yi/ /mi yi seng ge gang yin pal/ /mtshan ni stong nyid rdzogs pa yi/ /chos kyi rjes)zhes bya ba yin/ /gang gis 'di lta bu yi mtshan/ /'dzin par byed pa de dag ni/ /chos rnams stong pa'i don dag kyang / /yang dag ston par ༅'gyur zhes zer/ /da ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa yi/ /mi yi seng ge gang yin pa/ /mtshan ni bdags med rdzogs pa yi/ /chos kyi rje zhes bya ba yin/ /gang gis 'di lta bu yi mtshan/ /'dzin par byed pa de dag ni/ /skye 'gag med don gang yin pa/ /yang dag ston par 'gyur zhes zer/ /da 8ltar 'jig rten bzhugs pa yi/ /mi yi seng 40wa 669

ge gang yin pa/ /mtshan ni spyan nyid dag pa yi/ /kun 'dzin chos kyi rje zhes bya / /gang gis 'di lta bu yi mtshan/ /'dzin par byed pa de dag ni/ /mig zad mtha' don gang yin pa/ /yang dag ston par 'gyur zhes zer/ /rna ba sna lce lus nas ni/ /sgra dang ming la7sogs pa'i bar/ /chos ni nyi shu rtsa lnga dang / /me tog phrengasab spos dag dang / /mar me gdugasashedang gos rnams kyangakyi/ /thams cad de bzhin sbyar bar bya ⑤bam po lnga pa ste tha mkha/ de yi tshe na bcom ldan 'das/ / grong khyer7du ni gshegs pa'i tshe/ /bsam gyis mi khyab pa dag nidu/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi ni stobs rnams kyisathori/ /nam mkha' bar snang dag las ni/ /sgra snyan dam pa rab byung〈nyeste/ /gzungs kyi spyod pa sna tshogs dag /yang dag par ni bstan pas nanyuge / /'khor ni 'dus pa chen po rnams/ /'di lta bu yi tshig thos te/ /gzungs ni gang yin 'di dag gis(ge/ /mig gi 8zad mtha' gang yin dngasnyi/ /skye mtha' dang ni mtha' rnams dang / /rab dben7dang ni 'jug pa nas7/ /nye bar zhi ba'i bar rnams kyi(she/ /chos rnams gang yin de dag gis(ste/ /mthar phyin gnas ni gang yin pa/ /thams cad rab tu rtogs par byed/ /sbyin pa'i stobs ni gang dag gis/ /mthar shuste ni gang dag sdud pa dang / /tshul khrims stobs ni gang dag gis/ /mthar ni gang dag 'grubamanyepa dang / /bzod pa'i stobs ni gang dag gis/ /mthar ni gang dag bkod pa dang / /brtson 'grus stobs ni gang dag gis/ /mthar ni gang dag slong ba dang / / bsam gtan stobs ni gang dag gis/ /mthar ni gang dag sgom pa dang / /4)shes rab stobs ni gang dag gis/ /mthar ni gang dag ston pa dang / /yi ge rnams dngas rte40wa 670

brjod pa dang / /sgra skad rnams ni spangs pa nas①/ /gzugs dang sems kyi bar du yang / /mthar ni rnam dag nyid du rtogs/ /zag dang bcas dang zag med dang / /don rnams dang ni phan pa dag /thams cad stong zhing dben pa dang la/ /mthar ni rnam dag nyid du rtogs/ /srid pa dag ni thams cad la/ /rten cing gnas par mi byed dang / /gzungs dang ting 'dzin dag la ni/ /rab tu dben⑧par gnas par byed/ /'gro ba med cing 'ong med dang / /dge ba ma yin mi dge min/ /lung du mi ston pa yang min/ /bdag dang gzhan la phan 'dogs pa'i/ /de lta bu yi mtshan ma rnams/ /thams cad yongs su dag pas na/ /dbang phyug yon tan dag la yang / /gnas par yang ni mi byed do / /nyan thos dang ni skye bo dang / /sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos la yang / /gnas par yang ni mi byed do/ /mig ni zad pa'i mtha' dag dang / /skye mtha' dang ni mtha' rnams nasal/ /nye bar zhi ba'i bar rnams kyibya/ /spyod pa dag ni gang yin pa/ /thams cad yongs su zhi bar byed/ /skye ba dang ni mi skye dang ske/ /sdug bsngal dang nisnyibade ba dngas/ /bstod pa dngasheni smad〈kyepa dag⑨ /thams cad yongs su spong zhes zer/ /mthar phyin snang ba gang yin dang / /stong pa'i gzungs〈nyeni gang yin pa/ /thams cad rab tu gang rtogs pa / /'di5)nyid sangs rgyas spyod yul gonye/ /rab tu gnas par byed pa yin/ /'di nyid sangs rgyas rol pa yikha/ /gnas la〈nyerab tu gnas pa yin(9/ /'di nyid sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul la/ /rab tu gnas par gyur pa yin/ /'di nyid sangs rgyas mkhyen pa la/ /rab tu gnas par gyur pa yin/ /mig zad mtha' yi stobs dag go)/ /de bzhin du ni gnas pa dang / /migatshwanyeskye mtha' yi 48—671

stobs dag la/ /de bzhin du ni gnas pa dang / /mig gi mtha' yi stobs dag la / /de bzhin du 17ni gnas pa nas52/ /nye bar zhi ba'i stobs kyi bar(kye/ /de la rab tu gnas pa dang / /rna ba sna lce lus nas ni/ /sgra dang ming la sogs pa'i bar/ /chos ni rnam ④pa nyi shu lnga/ /thams cad de bzhin sbyar zhes zer/ /gzungs ciltani gang yin 'di nedag gis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi stobs/ /khyad par 'phags pa gang yin pa/ /yongs su rdzogs par byed ces zer/ /gzungs chos ni gang yin 'di dag gis/ /gzi byin mthu stobs des lta bu/ /yongs su rdzogs par byas nas ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /gnas kun la ni tsha'ajug pa dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /spyod yul kun la gnas gyur pas3 rme/ /'jig rten pa ni thams cad kun/ /lha ma yin gyi tshogs dag la/ /brtan51par 'dzin pa'i sems spangs nas/ /tshangs pa'i spyod la gnas par byed/ /gnod sbyin brgya stong tshad med dang / /grul bum dag ni tshad med rnams/ /de dag thams cad kun kyang ni/ /rab tu dga' 32ba skyed 1 par byed/ /dri za'i 'khor ni gang yin dang / / srin po'i 8'khor ni gang yin pa15/ /tshad skyemed grangs med de dag kyang / /rab tu dul la dga' bar byed/ /gal te tshangs pa'i 'khor rnams kyis/ /sgra snyan dag ni dam pa yis17/ /tshig 18dang don ni rjod byed kyang hurte/ /yang dag bstan par mi nus te/ /sems las byung ba'i chos rnams kyis/ /dpag par bya ba ma yin dang ske/ /sems las byung ba'i chos rnams kyis/ /gzung 2 bar bya ba min zhes zeral/ /gzungs 21ni gang yin 'di zhu dag ni lha/ /mig gis dmigs par bya ba min ske/ /gzungs ni gang yin 'di dag ni35/ /lus kyi bar gyis dmigs bya 40wa 672

min① / /gzungs ni gang yin 'di dag ni/ /mig gis dmigs par bya ba min / /mig gidza spyod yul bar gyis kyang / /dmigs par bya ba ma yin te/ /rna ba sna lce lus nas ni/ /sgra dang ming la sogs pa'i bar/ /chos ni rnam pa nyi shu lnga/ /thams cad de bzhin sbyar zhes zer/ /gzhan yang mig gi du —nozad mtha' dang ske/ /mig gernams kyi ni 95)skye mtha' dang / /mig gi mtha' dang 'jugatso)pa nas / /nye bar zhi ba'i 3)bar dag la/ /bdag dang skyes bu med pa dang / /sems dang srog ni med papo)dang / /de bzhin gang zag med pa dang / /mtshan ma med cing byed med dang / /'gro ba med cing 'ong med dang 1)/ /'di lta bu la sogs pa'i mtshan/ /thams cad rtogs par 'gyur zhes zer/ /gzhan yang 'di skad chos nyid kyi/ /mig ni rtogs par 'gyur zhes zer/ /gzhan yang 'di skad chos rnams las/ /grub pa'i mig ni gang yin dang / /ye shes mig dang shes rab mig /tshangs pa'i mig dang lha mig dang 31/ /tshangs par skyes nas hu)thob mig dang / / lhar ni skyes nas thob nyu2mig bodang / /tshangs pa'i rnam smin mig dag dang / /lha yi rnam smin mig dag dang / /tshangs pa'i rgyu las skyes pomig dang / /lha yi rgyu las skyes pa'i migatso /lha yi rdzu 'phrul mig dag dang / /lha yi brtson hu tsho'agrus dag gi mig /dman par skyes pa'i mig dag dang ske/ /khyadarka 'phags hu/skyes pa'i mig dag dang / /gshin rje'i 'jig rten gang yin pa/ /yongs su spangs pa'i mig dag dang / /klu dang gnod sbyin mig dag dang / /grul bum gyi ni mig na ridag dang / /yongs su gdung bcas mig dag dang / /yongs su gdungarmāḥmin mig dag dang / /rnam par dag pa'i mig dag dang / /rnam par dag min mig dag dang / / chur ring〈2zheng thung dgemig 40wa 673

dag dang / /nyan thos theg pa'i mig dag dang / /bsam gtan pa yi mig dag dang ske/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi mig dag dang / /spyod yul las byung mig dag dang / /'du shes las byung mig dag dang / /'dod chags las byung 17mig dag dang / /'dod chags bral ba'i mig dag dang / /rgyu las byung na ba'i mig dag dang / /rgyu min las byung mig dag dang / /mtshungs par ldan pa'i mig dag dang / /mtshungs par ldan min mig dag dang / / sgo brten ri4las byung 55mig dag dang //sgo 6las byung 7min mig dag dang / /rgyu rkyen las byung /mig dag dang / / rgyu sgo las skyes mig dag dang / /9sha las grub min mig dag dang / /ye shes rnam par dag mig dang / /yod pa min pa'i mig dag dang / /dmigs med bomig ni gang yin pa/ /thams cad rtogs 11par byed ces zer/ /rna ba sna lce lus nas ni/ /sgra dang ming la sogs pa'i bar/ /chos ni rnam pa nyi shu lnga/ /thams cad de bzhin sbyar zhes zer/ /de yi tshe na bcom ldan 'das/ /nam mkha' bar snang dag las 15ni/ /gzhan yang dpag tu med pa'i sgra 2/ /sgra snyan dam pa mchog byung nasang/ /khyad par 'phags pa gegazungs kyi chos/ /'di skad du ni bka' stsal te10/ / 'di yang 1 de bzhin gshegs pa yis18/ /rdzu 'phrul dag gis sprul pa yin/ /'di lta ste/ si le516/ ma le ma ri le/ sid dhe/ i ni/si ṇi 1/ ku lu ni yu/ ku lu ne yu/dag ku le ma le/na ku no 2 te/ a la shi ri / a si le tsi/ si si le 7te/ su si le / si le si le/ khyi bi le/ a bi le 9/ /su ṭi tsa na/ dha 21ni ma 2ni/ ka ni da/ ka la da4te/ su ka le/pra ya/ sha nang ni/ a nu lo si kye ri/ bi lo me phyi/ su bha ni ra re sheri snye/ a shi ri 9le/ sa ra ma pa ra phun te / pa ri bha 5 1he/ dha ji ra ni/ dhe 4 shu tsi ha /48wa 674

su dhedhi/ a tsa na/ bhu bo geg ga nangasnye/ kun pa no/ bha sa bhasnyinang /panasari 67ri ya/ ni pa ri ka no ni/ /ma rna〈bhasnyi/ su ru tsi ṭa6)/ pa na ā tsa (nyar/ a bhe hunyel bir+ya hu)pra ti 8sbyo ha/ dha ri 7ni/ a si ṭaski/ lo ṇi rnyitshonye/ /gzungs rnams gang yin 'di dag ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis rab tu brnyes/ /mthu chen dag ni phun sum tshogs(nye/ /shes rab dag ni tshad kyang med(te/ /'dzin pa dag ni yongs su spong / /dran pa dag ni dag par byed / /gzugs med 'gro dang 'ong ba med/ /phyogs dang phyogs mtshams yod pa min/ /mtshan ma med cing brjod dang bral/ /spros pa dag las yang dag 'das / /byang chub sems dpasaphu )sgrub byed na(nya/ /mthar ni bsil ba 'thob〈rtepar 'gyur/ /tshigs su bcad pa bye ba phrag /brgya stong mang po dag gis ni// tshig gcig5 nyetsam ni rab bstan kyang / /mtha' ni dmigs par yong mi nus/ /'phags pa mang pos rab tu bsngags/ /rnam par dag cing zhen pa med/ /'khor 'dus mang po thams cad kyis ste/ /shin tu gus pa skyed〈 snyepar byedagyu/ /gzungs ni gang yin 'di dag gi/ /dge ba'i chos kyi mthu stobs kyis( 7/ /nyon mongs rab bcom nyer zhu)zhi nas/ /khyad 'phags phan yon thob57par byed/ /yon tan dang ni shes rab dag /shin tu rgya che rgya mtsho 'dra/ /bzod pa dag ni sgrub5) par byed/ /sems ni rab bde g.yo med 'gyur/ /byang chub sems dpas5)rtag tu bsgoms/ /mkhas pa dag gis rab tu bsngags/ /dbul phongs5)dag ni spong byed cing / /nor dang rin chen 'thob nyepar byed/ /gzungs ni gang yin 'di dag gis/ /yon tan rnamasamusteni 'phel bar byed/ /rtag tu stong nyid la sogs pa'i/ /bden tshig dag gis rab tu brgyan/ /yi ge 48—675

dag ni 17spangs pas na/ /stong pa'i ngo bo nyid ces bya/ /sems dang rnamadzabashes spangs pas na/ /chos kyi ngo bo nyid ces bya/ /gzungs ni gang yin 'di dag gis / /dri bral rtag tu rnam dag byedabyucho/ /yang dag ye shes la gnas nas/ /phan pa sna tshogs ston par byed/ /sems can dag ni mang po rnams/ /dga' zhing dang ba skyed ri par byed/ /gnod sbyin 'khor57ni tshad med dang / /grul bum 'khor 47ni gang yin pa/ /'di la sogs pa yi dgas pa rgyal/ /dga' ba chen po skyed 4ces zer/ /gzungs sngags gang yin 'di dag ni/ /rab tu zhi zhing spros pa med/ /sems can dag la byams pas na/ /kun la bde ba sbyin par byed/ /bskal pa mang po brgya stong du/ /'gro ba rnams su rtag gnas shing ske/ /phan pa tshad med rab byed 8kyang / /rnam par dag cing gos pa med/ /tshigs su bcad pa brgya stong gis/ /bdud rtsi'irwa1chos ni rab bstan nas/ /sems can dag ni tshad med rnams/ /dga' ba chen po skyed nyu par byed/ /sngon gyi 1risangs rgyas tshad med rnams/ /shin tum rnam dag mos pa yis/ /gzungs 'di la ni brtenatshamanas su/ /rtag tu chos nyid dgongs par mdzad/ /tshangs dang brgya byin lha rnams dang / / klu yi 8rgyal po lha ma yin/ /gzungs 'di thos par gyur nas kyang 1 / /sems kyis (snyedaga' ba skyed ces zer/ /gzungs sngags gang yin 'di dag rnams/ /gang du gnas pa'i yul der ni/ /rtag tu gnod dang 'khrugs 17pa dang / /nad dang sdug bsngal mya ngan med/ /sems can dag ni thams cad kun/ /so sor zhuX dga' ba'i sems bskyed nas/ /gzungs 'di rtag tu bdag cag gi 1/ /sems la gnas par smon lam 'debs//gzungs sngags gang yin 'di dag ni rte/ /lus dang sems dang rkanas snyedag dang //40wa 676

kha mchu dag la gnas gyur na3)/ /yon tan dpag med skyedams par byedasno/ /gal te rtag tu 'dzin byed na/ /yon tan tshad med thob gyur nas/ /sems can mang la phan bya'adogs shing / /thams cad dga' ba thob ces zer/ /gzungs sngags gang yin 'di dag gis/ /sdig pa rnams ni rab spong zhing / /dam chos dag ni ston byed pas/ /thug pa med pa'i spobs pa 'thob457) sems can dag ni brgya stong rnams/ /the tshom dag ni rab bsal nas/ /nga rgyal rnams ni rab bcom ste/ /yon tan dpag med 'thob shigaces zer/ /shin tu zab cing gsang ba'i chos/ /gzungs sngags 3)gang yin 'di dag ni/ /mkhas pas rtag tu sems 7byed cing / /nan tan gyis ni sgrub par byed/ /shes rab go cha rabasgotshebagos nas/ /nyon mongs rab tu 'joms par byed/ /yon tan sems ni 'phel byed pas31/ /rab tu mos shing skyo ba med/ / gzungs sngags 12gang yin 'dirwagedag ni/ /grags pa chen po phun tshogs pas/ /zad pa dang ni mi zad dang mi/ /skye dang mi skye mtha' rab 8rtogs/ /'di 'dra'i shes rab sna tshogs kyis/ /bdag nyid rab tu brgyan pas na/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 7brgya stong rnams/ /shin tu gus shing nya tshomachod pa mdzad/ /de 'dra'i gzungs ni gang yin pa/ /rig pa /shedag gis rkang gnyis byed/ /ting 18'dzin mchog la rab gnas nas/ /byang chub lam la gzhol bar byed/ /zhi gnas lhag mthong rjes 'brang zhing / /zag med shes rab rtogs par byed/ /rab dang dbang po stobs du ༷ kyis ni/ /lag gnyis yongs su grub 31par byed/ /brtson 'grus dang ni bzod pa yis/ /nu ma gnyis ni grub par byed/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pas ni / /spyi gtsug dro gematshan nyid rab tu byed/ /mdo sde dag gis skud byas nas lha/ /40wa 677

so sor rig bzhi phreng ba brgyus1/ /sngon ni mngon par bsgrubasasngo pa yi ri/ /yon tan rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /dpe ni tshad med ji snyed pa/ /thams cad rab tu brgyan 5ces zer/ /gzungasam sngags gang yin 'di dag ni/ /yon tan tshad med phun tshogs pas/ /mig gis sngon dang phyi 8)mtha' dang / /zad dang mi zad mtha' dag dang / /skye ba dang ni mi skye dang / /mtha' dang mtha' min gang yin dang / /dben pa dang ni mi dben dang / /'jug pa dang ni 'jug min dang / /ci yang medamatshadang mi 'byung dang / /nyer zhi dang ni bdag 7med dang / /gang zag med dang srog med dang / /sems can med pa'i bar dag dang / /'di la sogs pa'i tshad med sgo11/ /thams cad rab tu rtogs par 'gyur/ /rna ba sna lce lus dang yid/ /yul drug dang ni 'byung chen rtebazhi / /'jig rten skye ba'i ming bar du/ /thams cad de bzhin sbyar zhes zer/ /gong du bsngags pa brjod pa yis / /gzungs mchog khodam pa gang yin pa/ /rab dben yon tan mchog ldan zhing / /sangs rgyas spyod yul yin pas na/ /gzungs don yang dag tshagang yin pa/ /yi ges brjod bya ma yin yang / /'jig rten pa yi rjes su ni/ /btags pa'i ming gis brjod pa yin/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das 'khor mang po dang thabs cig 7tu zla 'od gzhon nu'i khyim du byon pa dang / gdan bshams pa la rab tu bzhugs so/ /de'i tshe zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pas 1 bcom ldan 'das gdan 18la bzhugs par rig ste19/bdag nyid mchod pa'i yo byad mchog dam pa thogs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang 'khor 'dus pa chen po rnams la rab tu phul te mchod pa 2 de yang bsam gtan dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / bsam gtan gyi yon tan khyad par du 48wa 678

'phags pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mthu las mngon par grub pa sha stag go/ /de ltar mchod pa phul ba 1yang bdag 'ba' shig 5gi phyir ma yin gyi sems can tshad med pa thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub la gzhol zhing phan yonas chen po 'thob par bya ba'i phyir mchod cing phul bas na mchod pa des kun du khyab cing thams cad rab rngo tu tshim par sa7gyur to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das gdugs tshod gsol ba'i 'og tu 'khor 'dus pa mang po'i mdun du zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /gzhon nu rigs kyi bu 'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig theg pa chen po la gnas nas sbyin pa'i tshogs mngon par sgrub stso)par byed na yon tan khyad par du 77'phags pa rnam pa (cibargyad cu dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa brgyad cu gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/sems can yongs su smin par byed cing tshig snyan59pas yongs su sdud par byed pa dang / mtshan gya rnam pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang / dbang po rnams 1 snam tshang ba med pa dang / 'khor ba0stospangs nas mya ngan las 12'das pa mngon du byed pa dang / nyon mongs pa rnams zad nas dbang phyug mchog 'thob hunyepa dang ske/ yon tan phun sum tshogs shing sangs rgyas kyi zhing rab tu brgyan pa dang /'khor rnam par dag pa dang / gzi byin chen po dang ldan pa dang / shes rab phun sum tshogs pa dang / spyod pa khyad par du 'phags pa mchog mngon par grubalgepa dang / spyod pa bla na med cing mtshungs pa med pa yongs su rdzogs pa dang ske/ ci bag chags yang dag par bcom nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthams cad mkhyen pa'i spyod pa 'phel bar byed parwa dang / lus dang ring bsrel 32'jig rten thams cad dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis 48wa 679

mchod par 'gyur ba dang / ma rungs pa rnams rab tu btul bas mi'i rgyal po dang ske/ lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po dang / tshangs pa'i rgyal po rnams yongs su dang ba skye bar 'gyur ba dang / mthu chen po dang ldan pa dang / mdo'i sde dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / lung du bstan pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang / dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa dang / rtogs pa brjod pa dang / gleng gzhi 3)dang / / de lta bu'agebyung ba dang / skyes pa'i rabs dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / rmad du byung ba dang ske/ gtan la phab par bstan ri pa'i sde'i bar du sa)len pa dang / 'dzin pa dang ske/ yang dag par ston par 'gyur ba dang / sems la le lo med pa dang /chos la ser sna med pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi lam tshil yang dag par gnas pa dang ske/ 'jig rten na 6 mchog tu gyur cing dunaming dang gzugs yongs su dag par 'gyur ba dang / chos kyi sku mngon du byed par 'gyur ba dang / mi 'jigs pa thob par 'gyur ba dang / bsod nams phun sum tshogs par 'gyur ba dang / mu stegs can rnams zil gyis gnon pa dang / skyes bu dam pa'iphuchos phun sum tshogs pa dang / sdig pa can gyi spyod pa spong bar 'gyur ba dang /bsod nams dang ye shes kyi 59nirgyu la nyu mngon par yid ches pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos sdud par byed 31pa dang / bdud mang po kyi pham par byed pa dang /sangs rgyas kyis gsungs pa'i chos 1lhabaden pa dag la the tshom dang / nem nur med pa dang / 'dod pa ngan pa rnams rab tu bcom pa dang / gzi byin chen po dang ldan pa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa mngon par bsgrubs pas rdzu 'phrul khyad par du kha'aphags pa 'thob 8par 'gyur ba dang / skye shi spong 40wa 680

bar 'gyur ba dang / sems can yongs su smin par byed pa dang / spyod pa dpag tu med pa'i bsngags pa rjodas3)pa dang / yon tan rnams yongs su sdud par 'gyur ba dang / sems can rnams la spro ba skyed pal dang / chos kyi dga' ba la yongs su spyod kyepar 'gyur ba dang / sbyin pa gtong ba mngon par sgrubalgepar 'gyur ba dang / ye shes chen po'i sgor 'jug par 'gyur ba dang /bro rgyabar gyur pa'i chos la gnas par 'gyur ba dang / rigs nges pa nyid du 'gyur ba dang / chos kyi bzod pa bsgrub50par 'gyur ba dang / sangs rgyas kyi 7lam la bde bar gnas pa gang yin pa'o/ /gzhon nu rigs kyi bu 'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig sbyin pa'i tshogs 2rimangon par sgrub 1par byed na yon tan khyad par du nyu pho'aphags pa rnam 11pa brgyad cu po 'di dag phun sum nyu2tshogs shing yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ra3lha/ /de nas de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/ byang chub sems dpa' blo nyurtechen gang / /sbyin pa'i tshogs dang ldan pa la/ /phan yon mchog ni brgyad cu yod/ /ngas mdor7bsdus te bstan pa yin/ /gzhan yang dpag med bsam dka'amatshayi/ /yon tan dag ni gang yin pa/ /thams cad sbyin pa las skye stenyurte/ /deng 'dir cung 8zad bstan par bya/ /khyod 36kyis 'khor 'dus mang po la/ /mnyam pa'i sems kyis gang mchod pa/ /sbyin pa'i tshogs ni de dag la/ /mkhas pa rnams kyis bsgrub par bya/ /sbyin pa 'di yis 3 bsags pa yi/ /bsod nams phung po bsam mi khyab/ /mtshan dang dpe 21byad lus brgyan pa/ /thams cad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur/ /skye gnas dang ni rus rigs dang / /yul rnams dang ni khyim dag du 2dang / /grags pa dang 22ni gzugs dang sems/ /thams cad 48wa 681

yongs su dag par 'gyur/ /lha rnams rdzu 'phrul dngos po dang / /gzhal med khang dang lha mo dang / /rnam dag thogs med spobs pa yang / /sbyin pa las ni byung ba yin/ /sbyin pa'i tshogs mchog gang yin pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis 'di skad du/ /'di ni dang por byang chub rnams/ /gnas pa'i gzhi zhes bsngags par0)mdzad/ /byang chub sems dpa'aphubartson 'grus can/ /sbyin la the tshom med pabadag /nges pa'i sems la rab gnas nas/ /sbyin pa nan tan bsgrubs)par gyis/ /sbyin pa'i sems ni gang dag gis/ /bsod nams tshogs du5)ni rdzogs byed pa/ /byang chub sems dpas sgrub7byed na⑦/ /sangs rgyas byang chub 'thob tshonasapar 'gyur/ /sbyin pa'i mthu yi stobs kyis ni/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog ni rdzogs byed pas/ /zhing ni bye ba bsgul57byas kyangasngoX / /sems can rnams la gnod mi 'gyur/ /sbyin pa btang ba'i dbang gis na/ /rnam dag tshul khrims mang thos dang / /yang dag yid ches brtson 'grus dang / /ting 'dzin zag med shes rab 'dren/ /sbyin pa btang ba'i dbang gis na/ /dbang po stobs dang yang dag lam/ /yang 31dag spong dang rdzu 'phrul rkang〈nye/ /bag chags spong ba nyi 'dren par byed/ /sbyin pa btang ba'i dbang gis natso/ /rnam dag sgra snyan dag gis ni/ /zhing ni bye ba brgya phrag tu/ /dpag med chos ston 'dren par byed/ /yongs su dang bas sbyin btang bas/ /rdzu 'phrul rnams ni myur du 'thobasko/ /rdzu 'phrul yongs su rdzogs bya'i phyir/ /nan tan sbyin pa gtang labar gyis/ /lha ni mang po tshad med rnams/ /lha ma yin dang klu rnams dang ske/ /gnod sbyin brgya stong mang po dang / /'khor rnams kyis ni yongs bskor nas/ /gzhal med khang mchog rab zhugs t+na tshote/ /rang dbang dag gis 71wa 682

rtse byed pa①/ /'di lashesogs pa'i rgyal po rnams/ /sbyin la7brtson pa mthong gyur na/ /thams cad langs nas bsusnyinas ni/ /stan btingasnyemachod pa dag kyang byed/ /sbyin gtong gang zag gang yin pa/ /gzi byin chen po phun tshogs shing ske/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs la dbang thob pas/ /lha rgyal rnams ni sdud7par byed / /grul bum dngasani gnod sbyin rnams/ /thams cad skyabs su 'gro bar 'gyur / /dri za 'khor bcas rnams kyis kyang / /rol mo dag gis mchod par byed / /chom rkun dag ni7byams sems bskyed/ /ma rungs pa rnams ring du 'gro / /nor rnams nyams par mi 'gyur te/ /bang mdzod dag ni gang bar 'gyur/ /sbyin pa yongs su btang ba'i phyir/ /tshogs mchog dag ni rdzogasal )par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas ye shes thugatshwa)bar du/ /mu stegs chos ni spyod mi byed / /de la na ba yong5)med de/ /gzungs rnams yongs su srung〈nyebar byed/ /khyad par 'phags pa'i stobs rnams kyang / /sbyin pa las ni byung ba yin/ /de ltar sbyin pa gang gtongakheb/ /byang chub lam ni sgrubalgepar byed/ /mi dge ⑩bshes gnyen phrad mi 'gyur/ /spyod 'thunas snyegogs po 'thob7)par 'gyur/ /gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /sbyin pa'i03 tshogs ni sogs byed pa( te / /bsam gyis mi khyabasngo rtegazungs dag dang / /shes rab yongs su rdzogs byed pas/ /tshigs su bcad pa〈 nyetshad med kyis/ /kun 'dzin yang dag ston par byed/ /thams cad la ni thogs shu )med pas/ /ngo bo nyid don stor mi 'gyur / /byang chub sems ni rgya 25che la/ /mos pa'i sems ni brtan ( —9par 'gyur / /tshul khrims dag pa phun tshogs shing / /bdud kyi las rnams spong bar byeganye/ /'dod pa lnga la zhen med cing / /rtse gcigs rteyang dag dran pa zhu)40wa 683
